title: Dual-Channel Current Controller Design
description: Seeking an independent embedded hardware/firmware engineer to design, build, program, test and deliver one complete dual-channel low-voltage electrode controller and matching owned manufacturing files. This is original development from written functional requirements; no existing schematic, PCB or firmware. External nominal 12 V supply. Two electrode pairs operate simultaneously in shared water, with current/voltage limits, controlled polarity reversal, retained polarity state, manual timed dosing, simple buttons/selector and actual-current indication. No wireless, app, display or production batch. Engineer must procure and receive the prototype, program and debug it at their own or managed facility, obtain an agreed representative electrode test fixture, perform documented shared-water and enclosed thermal validation, correct agreed-scope design errors including necessary hardware/re-spins/retesting, and ship a verified complete controller with external supply to Toledo, Ohio. Owner will not test or troubleshoot unfinished hardware. Deliver native schematic/PCB CAD, Gerbers/drills, BOM/CPL, full firmware source/build files and binaries, enclosure cutout/DXF drawings, faceplate artwork, complete assembly/wiring documentation, finished-controller BOM and factory test procedure matching the tested unit, with IP ownership and freedom to manufacture elsewhere. Please provide fixed/capped total with labor, prototype hardware, test setup and shipping itemized, timeline, payment/acceptance milestones, relevant power/current-controller work you personally tested, lab arrangements and exceptions. Full detailed Revision C RFQ and numerical acceptance criteria will be supplied privately to suitable bidders. No treatment-efficacy, chemistry, electrode-life or certification studies requested.

Проект требует аппаратной разработки и физических испытаний, а бюджет составляет 15 USD.

title: Téléphoniste Soumissions Services Administratifs
description:
J’ai déjà en main une liste qualifiée de clients ainsi que la description détaillée de nos services professionnels et administratifs. 
Je souhaite confier à une téléphoniste les actions suivantes :

• Contacter chaque client de la liste selon les coordonnées fournies. 
• Recueillir, durant l’appel, toutes les informations nécessaires pour préparer une soumission précise (besoins, quantités, échéancier, interlocuteur clé). 
• Compléter le formulaire de soumission que je fournirai, puis me le retourner pour vérification. 

L’objectif n’est pas de vendre immédiatement mais bien d’obtenir des données fiables permettant d’émettre une proposition chiffrée. 
Je fournirai : script d’appel, argumentaire succinct, modèles de soumission et accès à notre ligne téléphonique ou outil VoIP au besoin. 

Une voix professionnelle, une bonne capacité d’écoute et une excellente maîtrise du français parlé sont indispensables. L’aisance avec les outils bureautiques courants (Google Sheets ou Excel) est également souhaitée pour saisir les informations collectées. 

Le volume initial représente environ une centaine de contacts ; si la collaboration est fluide, je prolongerai la mission sur le long terme.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент ищет телефонистку, которая обзвонит около 100 контактов из готового списка, соберёт данные для коммерческих предложений и заполнит форму в Google Sheets или Excel. Это ручная работа по телефону, а не разработка.
questions: Нужны ли какие-то технические доработки, например автоматическое заполнение таблицы из формы или интеграция с CRM?
Планируется ли использовать VoIP-инструмент с автоматической записью или логированием звонков?

title: Aplikasi Mobile Internal Perusahaan
description:
Saya ingin mengembangkan sebuah aplikasi mobile yang dipakai khusus oleh karyawan internal untuk mempermudah pekerjaan dan alur layanan harian. Fokusnya adalah kecepatan akses, tampilan yang sederhana, dan integrasi mulus dengan sistem yang sudah berjalan.

Ruang lingkup utama
• Aplikasi berjalan lancar di Android (jika Anda juga mampu menyiapkan versi iOS, mohon tulis di penawaran). 
• Autentikasi aman—email, nomor ponsel, atau SSO perusahaan. 
• Dashboard ringkas berisi tugas, notifikasi, dan status pekerjaan. 
• Form input untuk pencatatan data serta unggah foto/dokumen langsung dari ponsel. 
• Sinkronisasi data real-time ke back-end yang mudah diintegrasikan (REST API, Firebase, atau solusi serupa). 

Yang saya butuhkan dari Anda
1. Rencana pengembangan: pilihan teknologi (native, Flutter, React Native, dll.) + alasan. 
2. Tahapan waktu: wireframe, prototipe fungsional, rilis beta, hingga versi final. 
3. Contoh proyek sejenis yang pernah Anda selesaikan. 
4. Estimasi dukungan pasca-rilis untuk bug-fix dan peningkatan kecil. 

Output akhir
• Kode sumber lengkap dan terdokumentasi. 
• File build siap instal. 
• Panduan singkat deploy/install untuk tim IT kami. 

Saya akan memberikan detail flow bisnis serta aset desain setelah kerja sama disepakati. Terima kasih—saya menantikan solusi yang efisien dan mudah dipakai!

title: My Chip Server
description:
MyChipServer – Website & Dashboard Development (Fixed-price, per-item quote)

ABOUT US
MyChipServer (mychipserver.com) is a live browser-based service that gives developers remote access to real microcontroller boards (ESP32, STM32, RP2040, nRF52). Users reserve a board, flash firmware over JTAG/SWD, debug with GDB, view UART consoles, use a logic analyser and emulate sensors. We also have a CLI and REST API for CI pipelines. Customers are solo developers, engineering teams and universities.

This project improves and extends our existing website and dashboard. It is not a rebuild from scratch. Target go-live: 5–6 weeks from start.

CONTEXT
- Site and dashboard are already in production. Code access, known-issue list and an architecture call come after an NDA (shortlisted bidders only).
- US-registered company, billing customers in USD.
- Scale target: 2,000 registered users.
- Separate development and production environments, each with its own database.
- Hardware, board firmware and hardware-side data APIs stay with our team. Where an item touches hardware, you build the web side against our APIs.
- All code, designs and accounts (hosting, payments, analytics, email) belong to MyChipServer and stay in our name from day one.
- Tell us which tech stacks you work in. Our stack is shared with shortlisted bidders.

PRIORITY 1 – STABILISE, SECURE, GET INDEXED
1.1 Security hardening: review and fix database access rules and authentication; request validation, rate limiting and CORS on all APIs. Quote a cap in hours, re-confirmed after you see our issue list.
1.2 Fix broken flows: billing page saves plan/quota changes; waitlist signup works; re-test all main user flows.
1.3 Automated API tests: run in CI on every change, covering booking, workspaces and CI/CLI flows first.
1.4 Technical SEO: robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt; noindex on dashboard/login/signup; redirect logged-out dashboard visits; canonical tags and URL redirects; structured data, social share tags, unique titles/descriptions; security and cache headers; mobile LCP under 2.5s.
1.5 Accurate public content: correct pages that describe features, figures or certifications not yet offered. We supply the wording.
1.6 Branding (quote separately): positioning and messaging, logo, palette, typography, graphic samples.

PRIORITY 2 – CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE, REVENUE, ADMIN
2.1 UI redesign of website and dashboard: wireframes and user flows first, then visual design, then light animation. Responsive down to mobile.
2.2 Sign-up, login and teams: smoother sign-up; browse boards without an account, sign in only to reserve or run; invite team members; enterprise SSO (SAML) and SCIM.
2.3 Roles and multi-tenant admin: one login, view depends on role (our staff, organisation admin, teacher/team lead, student/member). We onboard a school or company and appoint its admin, who manages users and board sharing, bulk-invites from an email list (sent from our domain), and sees usage per group. One role system shared with 2.2.
2.4 Payments: one provider (Stripe or Lemon Squeezy – tell us which you recommend), USD. Price list, free trials, upgrades/downgrades, quotas or credits, invoices, webhooks.
2.5 Feedback page plus a button on every page, posted to Slack.
2.6 Analytics and error tracking: short tool proposal first; then GA4, Meta Pixel, Search Console, key events, and Sentry on front end and back end.

PRIORITY 3 – SCALE, PERFORMANCE, DASHBOARD FEATURES
3.1 Scaling and load testing (one combined item): review database, API and hosting limits for 2,000 users; enforce plan limits on reservations; shared rate limiter; load tests early and before launch.
3.2 Monitoring and public status page (hosted service is fine), building on Sentry from 2.6.
3.3 Logic-analyser viewer (web side only): improve the live waveform viewer, connection status and error handling, against our streaming API.
3.4 Usage dashboard for users and organisation admins, from a data API we provide.
3.5 Direct firmware upload with no 4.5 MB limit; UART log download.
3.6 Published API reference (OpenAPI where possible), including an endpoint that bundles a board's UART, logic-analyser and sensor data for users' own AI tools.

OUT OF SCOPE
Hardware platform and firmware, MCP server, internal ops console, mobile app, AI features, per-segment landing pages, third-party subscription fees (we pay those directly).

MAINTENANCE (QUOTE SEPARATELY – NOT A CONDITION OF THE BUILD PRICE)
- Free warranty on defects in your work for at least 60 days after launch.
- Monthly retainer: fee, included hours, rate for extra hours, whether unused hours carry over.
- Response times for P0 (site down / payments broken) to P3 (cosmetic).

YOUR QUOTE MUST INCLUDE
1. Hours and price for every item (1.1 to 3.6) and your hourly rate. Flag anything you'd combine, split or drop.
2. Who will do the work: roles, seniority, hours per week each.
3. Week-by-week timeline, with when we can review a deployed link.
4. Milestone payment schedule (e.g. 30% start / 40% mid-point / 30% launch).
5. Confirmation that all code, designs and repositories are ours and handed over in full.
6. Maintenance terms as above.
7. Two or three similar projects (SaaS dashboards with payments and role-based access).
8. Your assumptions and what you need from us.

Price in USD. Quotes without per-item hours will not be considered.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик ищет разработчика, который доработает уже работающий сайт и дашборд сервиса удалённого доступа к микроконтроллерам: усилит безопасность, починит платежи и waitlist, настроит SEO, добавит роли, SSO, оплату и аналитику. Бюджет 10 000 USD, срок 5–6 недель, объём работ большой и разбит по пунктам.
analysis.reply:
You're asking for a targeted upgrade of a live MyChipServer site and dashboard, not a rebuild. That means hardening security and rate limiting, fixing the billing and waitlist flows, getting the public pages properly indexed, and then adding the role-based multi-tenant admin, payments and usage views. I'd start with the stabilisation block (security review, broken flows, API tests in CI) so the live product is safe before any redesign. Technical SEO and the role system would run in parallel, with billing and analytics after that. I'd work in short sprints with a working demo at the end of each. Based on the scope, I'd expect Priority 1 in about two weeks and the full list within your 5–6 week window, depending on what the issue list shows. Could you confirm which items after 3.5 are included in the $10,000 budget? And is the SSO/SCIM work a separate phase, or part of the first release?

Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вы ищете точечное улучшение живого сайта и дашборда MyChipServer, а не перепись с нуля. Это значит усилить безопасность и rate limiting, починить потоки оплаты и waitlist, привести публичные страницы в порядок для индексации, а затем добавить мультитенантную админку с ролями, оплату и просмотр использования. Я бы начал с блока стабилизации (аудит безопасности, исправление сломанных потоков, API-тесты в CI), чтобы живой продукт был защищён до любого редизайна. SEO и система ролей могли бы идти параллельно, а оплата и аналитика — после них. Работать я планирую короткими спринтами с рабочим демо в конце каждого. По объёму я ожидаю Priority 1 примерно за две недели и весь список в рамках ваших 5–6 недель, в зависимости от issue list. Подтвердите, пожалуйста, какие пункты после 3.5 входят в бюджет 10 000 USD? И будет ли работа по SSO/SCIM отдельной фазой или частью первого релиза?

Портфолио с живыми демо: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

title: Multi-Number WhatsApp Admin Dashboard
description:
I need a straightforward web-based dashboard that lets me manage several WhatsApp Business numbers from one place. The core function is simple: for every connected number I must be able to send and receive messages in real time without touching the individual phones.

Key requirements
• Connect through my existing WhatsApp Business accounts (no Official API; the solution can mirror the QR-code approach or any other stable method that respects WhatsApp’s terms). 
• Display each number in its own tab or clearly labeled section so I can switch quickly. 
• Message view must show the full chat history and update live as new messages arrive. 
• Outgoing messages should deliver instantly and reflect in the original WhatsApp chat.

Nice-to-have (mention only if you can include them easily): viewing contact details, adding extra team members with role-based access.

Deliverables
1. Working web panel or desktop app ready for me to log in and start using. 
2. Setup guide that covers installation, device pairing, and how to reconnect a number if the session expires. 
3. Source code or compiled package plus any third-party library notes for future maintenance.

I value a clean, stable build over extra features, so keep the stack lightweight—Node.js, Python, or any technology you’re confident will stay reliable for long chat sessions.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет веб-панель для управления несколькими WhatsApp Business номерами: отдельные вкладки на каждый номер, живой чат с историей и мгновенная отправка сообщений без работы с телефонами. Подключение нужно через неофициальный способ (QR-зеркалирование), бюджет 50 USD.
analysis.reply:
Halo, saya memahami kebutuhannya: satu dashboard web untuk mengelola beberapa nomor WhatsApp Business, dengan tab terpisah per nomor, riwayat chat yang update secara real-time, dan pesan keluar yang langsung muncul di chat WhatsApp asli.

Pendekatannya: backend Node.js dengan library multi-device (misalnya Baileys atau whatsapp-web.js) untuk setiap sesi, WebSocket untuk pembaruan langsung, dan frontend ringan dengan tab per nomor. Sesi disimpan sehingga pairing tidak perlu diulang, dan saya sertakan panduan reconnect jika sesi kedaluwarsa. Estimasi pengerjaan MVP sekitar 5–7 hari.

Perlu diketahui, metode non-resmi ini berisiko pemblokiran akun oleh WhatsApp, jadi sebaiknya dipertimbangkan sebelum dipakai untuk nomor bisnis utama.

Berapa jumlah nomor yang akan dihubungkan, dan apakah nomor tersebut sudah bisa digunakan di WhatsApp Web?

Contoh demo live dapat dilihat di https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Здравствуйте, я понимаю задачу: одна веб-панель для управления несколькими номерами WhatsApp Business, с отдельной вкладкой на каждый номер, историей чатов в реальном времени и отправкой сообщений, которые сразу появляются в исходном чате WhatsApp.

Подход: бэкенд на Node.js с multi-device библиотекой (например, Baileys или whatsapp-web.js) для каждой сессии, WebSocket для живых обновлений и лёгкий фронтенд с вкладками по номерам. Сессии сохраняются, поэтому повторно сканировать QR не придётся; также добавлю инструкцию по переподключению, если сессия истекла. Оценка по срокам для MVP: около 5–7 дней.

Важно понимать: неофициальные методы несут риск блокировки аккаунтов WhatsApp, поэтому стоит это учесть, прежде чем использовать основные бизнес-номера.

Сколько номеров планируется подключить и уже ли они работают в WhatsApp Web?

Живые демо-примеры можно посмотреть здесь: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

title: Build Digital Product Online Store
description:
I’m launching “nexs ia and” as a fully digital brand and I need the entire storefront built from scratch. The shop will sell downloadable items only—think e-books, templates, audio loops and similar assets—so the flow has to stay streamlined: browse, pay, receive the file instantly.

Here’s what I want the finished site to handle: secure user accounts, a fast product search, simple product-upload screens on my end, automatic licence or download-link delivery on the customer side, and clean analytics so I always know what’s selling. The design should look modern and adapt flawlessly to mobile.

I’m open on platform choice; Shopify (with a digital-downloads app), WooCommerce, or a lightweight custom build in React/Next.js are all fine as long as checkout is rock-solid with Stripe and PayPal. Use whatever stack you’re most efficient with, just keep the code well-documented.

Deliverables 
• Live store on my domain, SSL in place 
• At least three sample products configured and tested 
• Payment gateway fully integrated and passing test transactions 
• Automated email sent after purchase containing a unique, expirable download link 
• Clear hand-over doc showing me how to add products and view orders 

Acceptance criteria 
The site must load under 2 s on mobile 4G, all test purchases complete without manual intervention, and every download link must remain valid for 24 h before expiring.

If this matches your skill set, let’s talk timeline and milestones—I’m ready to get started right away.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик запускает магазин цифровых товаров (электронные книги, шаблоны, аудиолупы) с каталогом, быстрым поиском, загрузкой товаров, автоматической выдачей ссылок на скачивание, которые истекают через 24 часа, и аналитикой продаж. Бюджет 750 USD, оплата через платформу.
analysis.reply:
You're looking to build a storefront for digital goods, such as e-books, templates, and audio loops, where buyers browse, pay, and get their file right away. The key pieces are a catalogue with fast search, a simple upload panel for you, automatic delivery of unique download links that expire after 24 hours, and basic sales analytics.

My approach is a lightweight Next.js build with a fast static catalogue, a small admin area for uploads, and signed, expiring download URLs generated for each order. I'd keep mobile layout and load time in focus from the start. I'd expect a first working version with the three sample products in about 2–3 weeks, followed by testing and a hand-over doc.

You can see live demos in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Two questions: Do you prefer your own file storage or a hosted option? And how many products do you plan to list at launch?

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вы хотите создать витрину для цифровых товаров, например электронных книг, шаблонов и аудиолупов, где покупатели просматривают каталог, оплачивают и сразу получают файл. Ключевые части: каталог с быстрым поиском, простая панель загрузки товаров для вас, автоматическая выдача уникальных ссылок на скачивание, которые истекают через 24 часа, и базовая аналитика продаж.

Мой подход: лёгкая сборка на Next.js с быстрым статичным каталогом, небольшой админкой для загрузки товаров и подписанными ссылками на скачивание, которые генерируются для каждого заказа и истекают. С самого начала я буду уделять внимание мобильной адаптивности и скорости загрузки. Ожидаю первую рабочую версию с тремя тестовыми товарами примерно за 2–3 недели, затем тестирование и документ передачи проекта.

title: Website Product & Price Upload
description:
I’m looking for someone who can take a folder of documents and images and turn them into polished, live listings on my online store. title: Complete Kotlin Train App & Publish
description:
Complete Existing Android Application – End-to-End Development & Google Play Store Publishing

Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced Android developer to complete my existing Android application and deliver a fully functional, production-ready application published on the Google Play Store.

The existing project is already developed to a significant extent using:

- Native Android
- Kotlin
- Jetpack Compose
- MVVM architecture
- Existing navigation and ViewModels
- Backend/API integration

I will provide the existing Android Studio project source code and related project files to the selected developer.

Important: This is an existing project continuation. I do not want the application rebuilt from scratch.

1. Existing Project Audit & Build Fixing

- Audit the complete existing source code.
- Fix Gradle and dependency issues.
- Fix compilation errors and runtime crashes.
- Resolve incomplete screens, routes and missing classes.
- Ensure the project builds successfully in Android Studio.
- Preserve all existing completed work.

2. UI/UX Development

Improve the existing application UI with a modern, premium and professional design.

Important requirements:

- Work only on the specified Live Train Status screen for the requested UI redesign.
- Implement exactly 8 API-based sections:
 1. Train Details
 2. Current Train Status
 3. Journey Progress
 4. Next Station
 5. Station Timeline
 6. Non-Stop Stations
 7. Location Messages
 8. Alerts & Disclaimer
- Use actual API response fields only.
- No fake data, dummy stations, hardcoded timings or fake locations.
- Hide missing, null and unavailable values.
- Do not unnecessarily change any other screen.

3. API Integration & Functionality

Audit and complete all pending integrations in the existing project.

Required features:

- PNR Status
- Live Train Status
- Train Search with Autocomplete
- Train Schedule
- Trains Between Stations
- Seat Availability
- Fare Enquiry
- Live Station Information
- Train Classes

Requirements:

- Use real API responses and provided credentials.
- Fix incomplete API calls and response parsing.
- Implement proper loading, error and empty states.
- Do not use mock APIs or hardcoded results.
- Preserve working integrations.

4. Train Alerts & Notifications

Complete and test:

- Saved train alerts and persistence.
- Station-based alarm scheduling.
- Notification permissions.
- Background notification behavior.
- Alert handling and notification reliability.

5. Backend & Security

- Audit and complete the existing backend/API proxy.
- Keep API keys and secret credentials on the server.
- Configure secure API requests.
- Implement proper error handling and caching where required.
- Ensure the Android app does not expose private API credentials.

6. Other Existing Features

Verify and preserve:

- Saved/Favourite Trains.
- Existing navigation.
- English and Hindi language support.
- Dark mode.
- App settings.
- Existing screens and functionality.

Do not remove or break completed features.

7. Testing & Quality Assurance

- Build and run the complete Android project.
- Test all major screens and functions.
- Verify API responses using real data.
- Test alerts and notifications on an Android device.
- Fix crashes and functional bugs.
- Perform regression testing after UI changes.

8. Google Play Store Publishing – End to End

The developer must prepare the application for production release.

Deliverables:

- Final working Android application.
- Updated complete source code.
- Debug/testing APK.
- Signed production release AAB.
- App icon and required graphics.
- Play Store screenshots.
- App description and listing content.
- Privacy Policy and Terms.
- Required Play Console declarations.
- Version code and release configuration.
- Internal/closed testing support as required.
- Production submission.
- Review correction support.
- Assistance until the application is approved and published on Google Play Store.

I already have a Google Play Console personal account.

The developer must coordinate the complete release process. Google Play approval is subject to Google's review.

9. Final Deliverables

1. Complete updated Android Studio project.
2. Working APK.
3. Signed release AAB.
4. Verified API integrations.
5. Working notifications and alerts.
6. Testing report.
7. Play Store listing materials.
8. Production submission and publishing assistance.

10. Strict Project Conditions

- Continue from my existing project.
- Do not rebuild from scratch.
- Do not damage existing functionality.
- Do not replace real API integrations with mock data.
- Do not make unrelated UI changes.
- Do not claim features are complete without testing.
- Share progress updates and modified-file details.
- All source code and release deliverables must be handed over.

Budget: ₹5,000 maximum fixed price.

Please inspect the existing project before bidding. Clearly state what you can complete within this budget, your estimated timeline, and your Android development experience.

Only developers experienced in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, API integration, backend security and Google Play Store publishing should apply.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужно доработать существующее Android-приложение на Kotlin и Jetpack Compose для расписания поездов: исправить сборку и падения, перевести экран Live Train Status на 8 секций с реальными данными API, подключить pending API через серверный прокси, настроить уведомления и подготовить публикацию в Google Play. Бюджет 12 500 INR при таком объёме низкий.
analysis.reply:
You need an existing Kotlin and Jetpack Compose train app finished: fix the build and crashes, rebuild the Live Train Status screen into eight API-driven sections, complete the pending API calls behind a server-side proxy, get the alerts working, and take it through Play Store release. I'd start with a code audit and build fixes to get a stable base, then the API layer and proxy, then the UI redesign and alerts, and finish with the release package. I'd keep your completed work intact rather than rebuilding from scratch. Given the scope, my rough estimate for the development part is 2–3 weeks after I review the source; store review timing depends on Google. Could you share the Android project and backend setup, and tell me whether you need full publishing support or only the signed release build? You can see live demos of my work here: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov

Я бы начал с аудита кода и исправления сборки, чтобы получить стабильную основу, затем слой API и прокси, потом редизайн UI и уведомления, и в конце пакет для релиза. С учётом объёма моя примерная оценка по разработке — 2–3 недели после изучения исходников; сроки проверки в сторе зависят от Google. title: Build Soccer Pinball Slot Game -- 2
description:
We are looking for an experienced 3D WebGL Game Developer to build "GOLERO - PAMBOLERO", a high-fidelity, mobile-first 3D skill-based soccer arcade game running smoothly at 60fps in modern mobile and desktop browsers.
Key Architecture & Scope (Detailed Technical Spec Attached):
• 3D Scene & Asset Integration (Three.js + Vite): Load our production .glb arcade cabinet (provided by our 3D artist with col_ physics colliders, 6 embedded Blender camera presets, separated emissive lamp/ring meshes, and modular UV-mapped textures for cosmetic skins).
• Deterministic 3D Physics (Rapier3D — Zero RNG): Implement 100% deterministic, skill-based ball and spring-plunger physics (fixed timestep, zero randomness/RNG) so identical plunger pull force and timing produce identical trajectories across devices—supporting asynchronous 1v1 Ghost Duels and decoupled server-side replay verification.
• Cinematic Cameras & Feedback (GSAP): Smooth camera transitions between the 6 .glb presets, spring compression visuals, emissive 7-segment LED scoreboards, dynamic SFX, and mobile haptics.
• Game Rules & Single Config (gameConfig.ts): Program the 5-ball match flow, 20-hole scoring matrix, consecutive-number straights, team badge combos, progressive multipliers (1X–128X), and expose all physics/scoring constants in gameConfig.ts.
• UI Integration (React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS): Integrate our 14 mobile-first (9:16) and responsive desktop (16:9) UI screens from Figma with clean API/JSON hooks.
Deliverables Expected:
• Clean, well-documented Git source repository (React + Vite + TypeScript + Three.js + Rapier3D + GSAP + Tailwind CSS) with decoupled deterministic physics/scoring module.
• Fully functional, mobile-optimized 60fps playable build ready for backend API hookup.

analysis.summary_ru: Разработка браузерной 3D-футбольной аркады на Three.js, Rapier3D, GSAP и React: импорт .glb-корпуса с шестью камерами, детерминированная физика мяча и пружины, правила подсчёта в gameConfig.ts и интеграция 14 экранов из Figma. Бюджет 750 USD, что мало для такого объёма.
analysis.reply:
You need a mobile-first 3D soccer pinball game for the browser: a .glb cabinet with six camera presets, a deterministic Rapier3D plunger and ball physics layer that can be replayed server-side, a single gameConfig.ts for scoring, and 14 Figma screens wired up through JSON hooks. I would split it into milestones: first the Vite, React and Three.js scene with asset loading and camera transitions, then the physics module with a fixed timestep and replay checks, then the scoring rules and UI integration. The fixed-timestep physics and the 60fps mobile target need the most testing, so I would leave time for profiling on real devices. For the scope described, 750 USD covers the first milestones, and the full build would likely take several weeks. Should physics determinism be verified across browsers or only in one reference environment? Are the 14 Figma screens final?

Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужна мобильная 3D-футбольная аркада для браузера: .glb-корпус с шестью пресетами камер, детерминированный слой физики мяча и пружины на Rapier3D, который можно проверять повторным воспроизведением на сервере, единый gameConfig.ts для подсчёта очков и 14 экранов из Figma, подключённых через JSON-хуки. Я бы разбил работу на этапы: сначала сцена на Vite, React и Three.js с загрузкой ассетов и переходами между камерами, затем модуль физики с фиксированным шагом и проверкой повторов, затем правила подсчёта и интеграция UI. - Experience with listing and order automation tools

Если ответ есть в моих инструкциях или предыдущей переписке — отвечает самостоятельно в пределах заданных полномочий. Если информации недостаточно — задаёт мне конкретный вопрос в Telegram.

Я отвечаю голосом. Ассистент распознаёт речь, сохраняет решение и отправляет ответ соответствующему исполнителю.

Рабочий процесс должен обходиться без ручного копирования сообщений между сервисами.

Необходимые функции

Получение новых откликов и сообщений, отправка ответов через доступные разрешённые интеграции.

Отдельная история по каждому заказу и собеседнику.

Одновременная работа с несколькими диалогами без смешивания сообщений и контекста.

Анализ предложений и подготовка индивидуальных ответов.

Приём голосовых и текстовых указаний через Telegram.

Постоянная память: мои требования, решения и информация по текущим задачам.

Загрузка и редактирование документа с инструкциями «Мнемос».

Два режима: самостоятельные ответы и отправка после моего подтверждения.

Журнал действий, уведомления об ошибках и возможность остановить автоматические ответы.

Финансовые обязательства и существенные решения — только после моего согласования.

Первый этап — проверка подключения

Конкретную площадку и примеры переписки сообщу подходящим кандидатам до согласования стоимости и начала работы.

Сначала необходимо продемонстрировать полный цикл: получение нового отклика и сообщения → анализ → вопрос мне в Telegram → мой голосовой ответ → отправка ответа нужному исполнителю.

Проверка проводится на нескольких параллельных диалогах. После подтверждения работоспособности подключения согласуем основную разработку.

Реализация и результат

Подойдут n8n, готовые сценарии, Python или другое обоснованное решение.

Нужны установка, настройка сервера и сервисов, тестирование, инструкция, передача исходного кода или сценариев и документации. Сервер и основные сервисы должны находиться под моим контролем.

Бюджет и отклик

Первоначальный ориентир — 10 000 ₽. Укажите, какой объём можно выполнить за эту сумму. Стоимость проверки подключения и основной разработки прошу указать отдельно.

В отклике напишите:

Как предлагаете реализовать задачу и проверить подключение площадки.

Какие похожие решения уже делали — желательно с демонстрацией.

Стоимость и сроки каждого этапа.

Ежемесячные расходы на сервер, ИИ и другие сервисы.

Технические ограничения и необходимые доступы.

Готов рассмотреть использование существующих решений и дальнейшее сопровождение после запуска.

title: Anti Medical Mafia Awareness Campaign
description:
Decades of watching myself how they testing...and friends and family pushed toward unnecessary tests, treatments, and even surgeries convinced me it is time to speak up. My goal is simple: shine a bright public spotlight on these practices so ordinary people recognise a sales pitch hiding behind a stethoscope. This project centres on a clear message—question recommendations that feel excessive, ask for evidence, and seek a second opinion.

The campaign must reach the general public in language that feels relatable, never alarmist, and always fact-based. I need a cohesive awareness package that travels easily across social media, community forums, and local events.

Deliverables
• A concise messaging framework that defines tone, key statistics, and talking points on unnecessary procedures. 
• Ten ready-to-publish social-media posts (graphics + copy) sized for the major platforms. 
• A printable one-page fact sheet suitable for clinics, pharmacies, and community boards. 
• A short (60–90 sec) explainer video script outlining the issue and encouraging informed consent.

Acceptance criteria: Every piece must cite reputable sources, avoid medical jargon, and present actionable steps the audience can take before agreeing to any test or surgery.

Preferred tools include Canva or Adobe Express for graphics and clear, accessible copy crafted in plain English. Once complete, I’ll handle distribution; your focus is creating compelling, share-worthy content that makes people pause and think twice before saying “yes” to the next unnecessary procedure.
P. S. My uncle Ivan were killed in a Hospital and some my friends too.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик ищет контент для кампании о неоправданных медицинских назначениях: messaging-фреймворк, 10 постов с графикой в Canva, печатный фактсheet и сценарий видео. Это контент-маркетинг и дизайн, а не разработка, поэтому проект не подходит.

title: UK Shopify High-Ticket Dropshipping Store Partner, Commission Only
description:
Hi,

I'm starting a UK Shopify store selling high-ticket items through dropshipping, and I'm looking for someone who knows what they're doing to build it and run it with me.

The idea is that you handle the main work. You find the right products, track down reliable suppliers (UK-based if possible), set up the store, and get it selling. After that you'd look after the day-to-day: orders, tracking, customer messages and the odd return.

I'm only interested in high-ticket products, so every sale needs to make at least £50 profit.

This is commission only. You'd get 30% of the net profit on every sale, which is what's left after the product cost, shipping, Shopify and payment fees, and any refunds. We'd agree any relevant terms and pay commission monthly through Freelancer.

The store, domain and related accounts will be in my business name, and I'll give you full staff access to work on everything.

If you're interested, please send me:
- Screenshots of Shopify stores you've run, showing real sales
- 2 or 3 high-ticket product ideas you think would sell in the UK, with rough profit figures
- How you'd go about getting the first sales

I want to work with someone who's done this before and can show it, so please only apply if you have real results.

Thanks, and I look forward to hearing from you.

title: Website With Booking & WhatsApp Alerts
description:
I need a clean, professional business site whose core feature is an online booking system. Visitors must be able to see available dates and times, choose a slot, and confirm it in real-time. The moment a booking is completed I want the full reservation details pushed automatically to my WhatsApp so I can reply on the go; I do not plan to manage bookings inside the site or by email.

Key expectations 
• Responsive design that feels intuitive on mobile and desktop. 
• Clear step-by-step flow for the user: select service → pick date/time → enter contact info → instant confirmation message. 
• WhatsApp API or approved integration that forwards each reservation with customer name, chosen slot and any notes. 
• Simple way for me to adjust available time slots and blackout dates without touching code.

Hand-off deliverables: finished site on my hosting, admin credentials, and a short walkthrough video so I can update schedule settings myself.

If you have a preferred framework or plugin for the booking calendar, mention it; performance and ease of use are my top priorities.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент хочет чистый адаптивный сайт с онлайн-записью: выбор услуги, даты и времени в реальном времени, контактные данные и мгновенное подтверждение. Каждое бронирование должно автоматически отправляться в WhatsApp, а расписание и выходные дни нужно менять без кода. Бюджет 50 USD для такого объёма низкий.
analysis.reply:
You want a clean booking site where visitors pick a service, see open slots, and confirm instantly, with each reservation forwarded to your WhatsApp right away. I would build a responsive site with a step-by-step flow, plus a simple admin panel for editing time slots and blackout dates without touching code. For the WhatsApp alerts I would use the WhatsApp Business API or a provider such as Green API or Twilio, depending on what you can set up. A rough timeline is 1–2 weeks for the core, including hosting setup, admin access, and a short walkthrough video. Two questions before I start: do you already have a WhatsApp Business account with a number approved for API use, and how many services or staff calendars do you need?

Portfolio with live demos: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужен чистый сайт с онлайн-записью: посетитель выбирает услугу, видит свободные слоты и мгновенно подтверждает бронь, а каждая запись сразу уходит в ваш WhatsApp. Я бы сделал адаптивный сайт с пошаговым сценарием и простую админ-панель для редактирования слотов и выходных дней без работы с кодом. title: Complete Website Development

• Implement a user-friendly content management system (WordPress, Webflow, or a comparable platform) so I can update text and images on my own. 
• Ensure the site loads quickly, looks great on mobile, tablet, and desktop, and meets basic accessibility best practices. 
• Configure essential SEO settings and connect Google Analytics so performance is tracked from launch. 
• Provide brief hand-over documentation or a walkthrough video explaining how to edit pages, add posts, and manage plug-ins. 

Nice-to-have (let me know what you can include): a contact form with map, a simple gallery to showcase work, or a payment/booking add-on that can be activated later without rebuilding the site. 

Please share links to two or three live websites you’ve built that demonstrate clean design, solid performance, and straightforward navigation. If selected, we’ll start with a quick call to confirm brand colors, domain/hosting details, and timeline before you draft the initial wireframe.

title: Eselt WooCommerce eBay Setup

Because I don’t yet have an eBay seller account, you’ll also walk me through creating and verifying one for eBay Australia, then link it to WooCommerce via Eselt’s API token.

• Eselt plugin installed, activated and fully configured in WooCommerce 
• New eBay Australia seller account created, verified and linked to Eselt

Two questions: roughly how many products are in the store, and do any of them use variations? Also, do you already have shipping rates and a returns policy in mind for eBay AU?

title: Build Scalable Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform
description:
We are looking for a software engineer to design, build, and scale our cloud-hosted Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform. You will own end-to-end features across the application stack, enforce multi-tenant data isolation, and deliver reliable, zero-downtime releases for recurring subscription customers.

Responsibilities

• Multi-Tenant Architecture & Data Layer: Design and maintain backend services, APIs, and relational/real-time databases with strict tenant isolation and role-based access control (RBAC).
• Auth, Billing & Subscriptions: Implement user onboarding, organization/workspace management, tiered subscription plans, usage metering, and billing webhook flows.
• Frontend & User Workflows: Build responsive web interfaces, core product workflows, analytics views, and self-serve admin/account controls.
• Integrations & Automation: Develop third-party API integrations, background jobs, and automated workflows to support customer operations.
• Reliability, Security & CI/CD: Maintain automated test suites, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring/observability, data backups, and security/compliance controls.

Qualifications

• Proven experience building and shipping production SaaS applications or cloud-native web platforms.
• Strong command of modern backend and frontend technologies, relational databases, and API design.
• Practical understanding of multi-tenancy, authentication/authorization, subscription billing flows, and cloud deployments.
• Strong debugging, testing, and system design skills with a focus on reliability, security, and maintainability.

I'd start with the tenancy model and the auth layer, since everything else depends on them, then add billing and usage metering, followed by the core workflows and integrations. I work with a modern stack and AI assistants, so early milestones move quickly. A first working slice with auth, organizations, and one subscription plan could be ready in about 2–3 weeks. At 750 USD, the budget fits a well-defined first phase rather than the full platform, so I'd suggest we scope it that way. See live demos in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

• Forms, messages, and support requests 
• Content, reports, and analytics 

Once the data is in hand, the agent must decide what action to take—updating records, triggering workflows, or pushing results back to the interface—without breaking existing functionality. You’ll need to wire these capabilities into the current codebase, expose any new endpoints, and keep the overall UX seamless.

I handle deployments on a private Git repo and a VPS stack, so your pull requests should be clean, documented, and production-ready. Familiarity with OpenAI APIs, LangChain, or similar toolkits will help you move fast, but I’m open to the stack you’re most productive with as long as it slots smoothly into React and Node.

If this blend of feature development, refactoring, and AI integration sounds like your wheelhouse, message me with a brief outline of how you’d approach the first automation task.

title: Build B2B Wholesale Ordering Portal wordPress
description:
WordPress B2B Wholesale Ordering Portal (Phased Build)

Project Summary:
We are upgrading an existing live WordPress site into a private, gated B2B wholesale ordering portal for a poultry and egg supplier in Southern Africa. Wholesale pricing and ordering must be restricted to verified business buyers, support local currency (NAD / N$) and 15% VAT rules, enable fast bulk ordering, and automate order alerts and back-office workflows across structured phases.
All client, business, pricing, and buyer details are strictly confidential. We are looking for quotes broken down clearly by phase so we can review scope, timelines, and milestones.

Phase Breakdown:
 * Phase 1 — Gated B2B Portal, Bulk Ordering & Instant Alerts
 * Clone the live WordPress site to a private staging environment with zero downtime to the live site.
 * Build a B2B registration workflow capturing company details, business registration numbers, and VAT/tax IDs, with a manual admin approval step (pending vs. approved) that gates wholesale pricing and checkout.
 * Configure NAD / N$ currency, 15% VAT calculation, product listings (SKUs, pack sizes, stock status, and minimum order quantities), and a fast spreadsheet/matrix-style bulk order sheet.
 * Set up Direct Bank Transfer (EFT) checkout, automated order confirmation emails to buyers and internal office/accounts addresses, and real-time mobile/WhatsApp order notifications.
 * Structure product, customer, and order data cleanly so Phase 2 can plug in without refactoring the core setup.

 * Phase 2 — Warehouse Operations & Financial Document Automation
 * Generate consolidated picking and packing lists for warehouse/ground staff (sorted by product type and delivery route/schedule).
 * Auto-generate itemized driver delivery notes with delivery details and customer sign-off blocks.
 * Implement clear order status stages (e.g., Pending, Paid, Processing, Packed, Dispatched, Delivered).
 * Generate tax invoices for accounting and support credit notes (for adjustments such as weight or quantity variances).

 * Phase 3 — Online Payments & Scaling Enhancements
 * Integrate online card/local payment gateway options and support refund workflows alongside EFT.
 * Support future operational scaling (such as standing/recurring orders, catch-weight adjustments, or reorder tracking).

How to Quote:

Please include:
 * Separate cost estimates and estimated timelines for Phase 1, Phase 2, and Phase 3 (and note if you recommend milestone splits within each phase).
 * Relevant past work building gated B2B wholesale portals, bulk order forms, order alerts, and fulfillment/invoicing workflows.
 * Any clarifying questions before we share staging details under confidentiality.

description:
Part-Time Tour Consultant

We are seeking a reliable, professional, and customer-focused Tour Consultant to support our sales of customized New Zealand, Australia, and South Pacific tours.

In this remote freelance role, you will assist prospective travelers by responding to inquiries, discussing travel plans, and helping create personalized itineraries that match their interests, budget, and travel style. Whether adapting one of our existing tour packages or designing a fully customized journey, you will play a key role in delivering exceptional customer service.

Responsibilities
• Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries using Microsoft Outlook, dedicating approximately 2 hours per day to email communication. 
• Responses should be personalized, accurate, and written independently without the use of AI-generated content.
• Communicate with New Zealand-based suppliers and partners via email and phone to gather information, availability, and pricing.
• Collaborate closely with your U.S.-based colleague via email and phone
• Customize existing itineraries and help design personalized travel experiences for clients.
• Provide accurate, professional information about our destinations, tours, and services.
• Assist clients with itinerary details, booking procedures, and general travel questions.
• Develop a thorough understanding of New Zealand destinations, attractions, accommodations, and transportation options.
• Maintain a friendly, professional, and customer-focused approach in all communications.
• Follow up with prospective clients and help guide them through the booking process.

Requirements
• Native-level or fluent English, both written and spoken.
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel.
• Basic familiarity with Claude.
• Passion for travel, customer service, and itinerary planning.
• Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple inquiries efficiently.
• Willingness to learn about New Zealand destinations, tourism products, and travel logistics.
• Availability during U.S. business hours.
• Commitment to responding to customer inquiries within 24 hours.

Preferred Qualifications
• Previous experience in customer service, travel consulting, tourism, hospitality.
• Experience communicating with international clients and suppliers.
• Knowledge of New Zealand destinations and tourism products is an advantage, but not required.

What We Offer
• Compensation of USD $250 per month.
• Fully remote, work-from-home position.
• Flexible part-time schedule.
• Opportunity to work in the travel industry and help clients create memorable vacations.
• Long-term freelance opportunity for the right candidate.

How to Apply

• Updated in-text citations and reference list in APA style ONLY.

title: AI Telegram Support Chatbot
description:
I need an AI-powered customer-support chatbot that lives on Telegram and uses the OpenAI GPT API for natural, context-aware conversations. The bot’s primary job is to answer questions pulled from a prepared knowledge base, gather any missing customer details, and, when it reaches the edge of its knowledge, quietly alert a human agent in a private chat so the agent can step in from within Telegram.

Core expectations 
• Real-time messaging with full conversation history so the model keeps context between turns. 
• Easy-to-tune behaviour: I want to adjust tone, fallback thresholds, and knowledge-base content without redeploying code. A lightweight web or CLI admin panel is fine as long as it’s clear and secure. 
• Structured data capture: name, e-mail, order ID, or other fields saved to a small support-request table (PostgreSQL or similar) that I can export. 
• Smooth agent hand-off: when escalation is triggered, the bot privately pings a predefined staff account, then stays silent while the human replies through Telegram. 
• Production-ready code—Python or Node.js—well modularised, commented, and delivered via Git. Include setup scripts, environment templates, and deployment notes for a VPS or Docker container. 
• Reliability and scale: graceful error handling, retry logic around both Telegram Bot API and OpenAI calls, and basic rate-limit awareness.

Please show one or two live or past Telegram bots you built—especially anything that calls OpenAI or maintains multi-turn context—so I can gauge style and robustness.

Once we agree on scope, I’ll provide the knowledge-base content and agent credentials, then we can break delivery into milestones: initial MVP bot, admin tools, final polish & deployment.

Настройки тона, порогов эскалации и базы знаний должны меняться через админ-панель без передеплоя.
analysis.reply:
You need a Telegram support bot that answers from your knowledge base through GPT, keeps the full conversation context, collects customer details into an exportable PostgreSQL table, and hands off to a staff account when it reaches the limit of its knowledge. I would build it in Python with a retry layer around both the Telegram and OpenAI calls, and store the knowledge base, tone, and fallback thresholds in the database so you can edit them from a secured admin panel without redeploying. Deployment would be Docker on a VPS, with environment templates and setup notes. Following your milestones, the MVP bot would take about 1–2 weeks, admin tools and the data export another 1–2 weeks, and then polish and deployment. Two questions: roughly how many knowledge-base documents do you expect, and should escalations go to one staff account or to several? You can see live demos of my work at https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Unreal Engine 5 Multiplayer Prototype
description:
I’m assembling a concise but expandable multiplayer foundation in Unreal Engine 5 and need a solid prototype that my team can extend with confidence. 

Core gameplay for this first build is simple: players must be able to move freely, collect items scattered around a single map, and complete objectives tied to those items. To keep sessions lightweight, they’ll host the match locally and let friends join via a listen-server setup—no external matchmaking services for now.

Here’s what I expect in the delivered project: 
• A fully replicated character controller covering movement, jumping, and interaction with collectible objects. 
• One small, production-ready map that includes item spawns, objective logic, and clear start/finish flow so we can demonstrate victory conditions. 
• Clean Blueprint graphs or well-commented C++ (your choice, but keep the style consistent) with sensible server-authority decisions. Replication rules should be obvious at a glance. 
• A straightforward host/join flow: press “Host Game” to create a listen server and expose the session; friends connect from the same UI without needing IP addresses. 
• Inline comments plus a brief document explaining where to plug new mechanics, how to add more maps, and any key replication patterns you used.

If you can set up basic input mapping for gamepads, that’s a bonus, but not mandatory.

I’ll supply concept art, reference gameplay videos, and any placeholder assets you might need on day one. Aim for clarity, maintainability, and network stability over visual polish; we’ll layer art and extra systems afterward. 

Let me know the engine version you’d like to work in, your estimated timeline, and anything you need from me to start.

analysis.summary_ru: Клиент ищет прототип мультиплеера на Unreal Engine 5 с listen-сервером, контроллером персонажа, сбором предметов и целями на одной карте, бюджет 750 USD. Это игровая разработка на UE5, которая не входит в услуги по вебу, ботам, Mini Apps и SaaS.
questions: Нужен ли клиенту игровой движок Unreal Engine 5 или проект должен быть на веб-технологиях?

title: Friendly Rebrand Facebook Post
description:
I’m ready to tell our community that Black Tie Auto Detailing has officially rolled up its sleeves and become Down ‘N Dirty Detailing. I need a single Facebook post that feels warm, local, and conversational—something a neighbor would happily share—while still sounding confident about the upgrade.

Here’s what has to shine through:
• Clear rebrand statement: Black Tie Auto Detailing is now Down ‘N Dirty Detailing. 
• Our brand-new website is live and, above all, makes booking faster and simpler than ever. 
• We’re switching to straightforward flat-rate pricing—no surprises at checkout. 
• Strong invitation to book a detailing service right from the post.

Keep jargon to a minimum, weave in a hint of small-town friendliness, and aim for a post length that fits comfortably on a single Facebook screen (roughly 80–120 words). A punchy opening line, smooth flow, and a crisp closing call-to-action are what I’m after.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик просит написать один пост для Facebook о ребрендинге автомойки Black Tie Auto Detailing в Down 'N Dirty Detailing, с упоминанием нового сайта для онлайн-записи и плоских цен. Это копирайтинг и маркетинг, а не разработка.

title: Teleoperador B2B para Restaurante Ibiza
description:
Somos Carpe Diem, un restaurante y pizzería con servicio de delivery en Ibiza. Buscamos un/a teleoperador/a freelance con experiencia en llamadas comerciales B2B y residencia en España.

El proyecto consistirá en:

1. Investigar y crear una lista de 50 empresas cercanas al restaurante (aproximadamente a 10 minutos en coche) utilizando información empresarial pública. Esta lista deberá especificar empresa, sector, teléfono, email o WhatsApp comercial, enlace de Google Maps o página web.
2. Preparar la lista completa en un documento colaborativo de Google Sheets.
3. Realizar llamadas comerciales B2B exclusivamente a las empresas aprobadas, utilizando un número visible español.
4. Presentar brevemente "Carpe Diem" y nuestras ofertas para empresas: comidas para empleados, delivery, promociones especiales y menús para grupos (incluyendo opciones especiales como menús navideños).
5. Detectar interés y solicitar autorización para enviar información adicional por WhatsApp o email.

Requisitos del perfil buscado:

- Residencia en España.
- Dominio natural del español y buena dicción.
- Experiencia previa en telemarketing, ventas telefónicas o campañas B2B.
- Voz agradable, segura y profesional.
- Habilidad organizativa y manejo competente de Google Sheets.
- Posibilidad de emitir factura.
- Se valorará experiencia específica con restaurantes, servicio de delivery o captación de empresas.

Notas adicionales:
Las llamadas serán realizadas dentro del horario comercial español en bloques de aproximadamente 2–3 horas diarias durante varios días.

analysis.summary_ru: Ресторан и пиццерия в Ибице ищет фрилансера-телеоператора для холодных B2B-звонков: поиск и оформление списка из 50 компаний в Google Sheets, звонки и предложение услуг ресторана. Это ручная продажа по телефону, а не разработка.

title: Scale My Indian Dropship
description:
I opened my Indian dropshipping store just a month ago and, in that short time, it has generated ₹55 K in gross revenue. The problem is that it cost me ₹15 K in ads to get there, only 34 % of orders are actually delivered and a painful 64 % end up as RTO. I no longer have the hours to turn this around, yet I know the store can do far better.

Your mission is to step in, apply a proven strategy, and take the operation to at least ₹2 L net profit. I am looking for someone who lives and breathes direct-response marketing and e-commerce, not a generalist or engineer dabbling on the side. You should arrive with a clear plan to:

• Slash RTO, improve delivery rates and customer experience 
• Optimise product line-up, pricing, offers and creatives 
• Run, scale and refine paid campaigns (Meta Ads, Google Ads or any channel you know will work) until we hit dependable profitability 
• Report performance in simple weekly snapshots so I can see CAC, ROAS, net margins and cash flow at a glance 

You will have the access you need to product catalogue, ad accounts and dashboards; I only step in for approvals and payouts. The target is non-negotiable: consistent, trackable profit—the store must pay for itself and then some.

If you have run Indian dropshipping stores past the ₹2 L monthly profit mark before, let’s talk. Show me real numbers, outline your approach, and tell me how quickly you can make this channel self-funded and scaling.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик ищет специалиста по performance-маркетингу для дропшиппинг-магазина в Индии: снизить RTO, настроить рекламу в Meta/Google Ads, оптимизировать ассортимент и выйти на прибыль от ₹2 L в месяц. Это маркетинг и ведение кампаний, а не разработка.
questions: Нужна ли вам техническая доработка самого магазина (сайт, оформление, интеграции с курьерскими службами), или задача только в маркетинге и рекламе?

title: Senior Full-Stack SaaS Technology Partner - Rapid Development (matter of days, not weeks) - Read description before sending a message

Clear functional requirements, specification documents, UI/UX mockups, interactive prototypes and AI-generated project source code will be provided. The expectation is to review, enhance, troubleshoot, test and rapidly transform these into secure, scalable, production-ready web and mobile applications.

Engagement Expectations:

Work exclusively within our company-provided VDI environment.

Independently resolve technical challenges with minimal supervision.

Proactively provide daily status updates without requiring follow-ups.

Take end-to-end ownership of deliverables and production readiness.

Work on a milestone-based payment model.

Trust, accountability, quality, transparency and strict adherence to agreed timelines and deadlines are non-negotiable.

title: Chatbot WhatsApp Estado Pedidos
description:
Necesito poner en marcha un agente automático en WhatsApp que atienda a mis clientes las 24 h respondiendo únicamente consultas sobre el estado de sus pedidos, envíos o reservas. Toda la información debe leerse en tiempo real desde mi tienda en línea, de modo que el cliente escriba su número de pedido y el bot devuelva la última actualización disponible sin intervención humana.

Algunas referencias técnicas:
• El e-commerce está montado en (indícamelo al iniciar la propuesta: Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento u otro) y dispongo de acceso API/WEBHOOK para extraer datos de órdenes y tracking. 
• El canal de WhatsApp Business ya está verificado y activo; faltaría la integración vía Cloud API, Twilio o la solución que sugieras. 
• Mensajería en español; si la arquitectura lo permite, que sea multilenguaje a futuro. 

Entrego credenciales y textos de respuesta preferidos; tú te encargas de:
1. Conectar la fuente de datos de la tienda. 
2. Configurar el flujo donde el bot reconozca el número de pedido, valide al cliente y devuelva estado, link de tracking y fecha estimada. 
3. Pruebas de estrés básicas para asegurar disponibilidad 24/7. 
4. Manual breve (PDF o vídeo corto) para que mi equipo pueda modificar respuestas o volver a desplegar en caso de cambios.

Criterio de aceptación: antes de liberar el hito quiero ingresar un pedido de prueba y recibir en WhatsApp la respuesta automática correcta en menos de 5 segundos.

Работа включает подключение API магазина, настройку WhatsApp Cloud API или Twilio, нагрузочные тесты и короткую инструкцию для команды. Бюджет 25 USD явно не соответствует объёму задачи.
analysis.reply:

Lo montaría con WhatsApp Cloud API conectada a un webhook que consulta la API de tu plataforma, y dejaría los textos y el flujo de validación en una configuración sencilla que tu equipo pueda editar. Calculo entre 3 y 5 días para la integración, las pruebas de carga y el manual. Puedes ver demos en vivo en https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

title: Wholesale / Bulk Liquidation Pricing for 4,000 IT Items
description:
I have a spreadsheet of roughly 4,000 computer-related lines—desktops, laptops, printers, parts, and assorted accessories. For every line I already list the item name, brand, model number, and quantity, but I need expert help turning those particulars into realistic numbers I can present to wholesale or bulk buyers.

What I’m after for EACH line:

• A current wholesale price that reflects today’s market for mixed-condition stock. 
• A bulk liquidation price that shows what I could expect if I moved the same lot quickly to a surplus or pallet buyer.

Because the inventory ranges from fully functional gear to units that are incomplete or damaged, I’m relying on you to factor condition spreads into both figures. Where possible, please lean on recent wholesale catalogs, distributor sheets, B2B auction results, and recycled-electronics marketplaces to support your estimates. description:

What the client wants: A Python agent that finds Amazon products suitable for importing from China. It builds candidate lists, scores products, checks Google Trends, finds Alibaba suppliers, and calculates profit under normal and stressed conditions. It runs on a Linux cloud VPS on a schedule, and it only recommends. A human approves every purchase, supplier contact, and listing.

Hard rules:

No scraping Amazon. Use licensed sources only: Keepa, Jungle Scout or Helium 10, and Amazon SP-API.

Production runs on a Linux VPS, not a personal computer or shared hosting.

The developer builds everything from scratch in a new repository. The reference files are not a codebase to build on and do not override the post.

Timeline: 2 weeks (10 working days)

Budget: Pricing is based on the bidder’s proposed amount. Bidders should not ask for the client’s budget.

Stages: 0. Access and server setup (Days 1–2): Provision and harden the VPS, test each data source from the server, and document access.

Candidate list builder (Days 2–5): Pull the top 100 items per category for 5 categories, deduplicate by ASIN, and group into niches. Deliverable: candidates.csv.

Filters and scoring (Days 2–5): Apply hard exclusions, score products on weighted metrics, and rank them with source and date for every metric. Deliverable: ranked_products.xlsx.

Google Trends (Days 7–8): Analyze the top 10 finalists for slope and seasonality, with charts. Deliverables: trend_scores.csv, trends_report.xlsx, charts/.

Supplier finder (Days 7–8): Collect the top 3 Alibaba suppliers per finalist and flag risks. Deliverable: suppliers.csv.

Profit calculator (Days 6–7, re-run after Stage 4): Calculate landed cost, fees, and net profit, with four stress scenarios. Deliverable: profit_model.xlsx.

Testing (Days 8–9): Unit, error-handling, and hand-checked tests, run inside Docker on the VPS. Deliverables: tests/, test_report.md.

Deployment and handover (Days 9–10): Deploy with Docker and cron, complete documentation, run the demo, and hold a 60-minute recorded walkthrough.

Deployment requirements: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (or current LTS), at least 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, and 40 GB SSD. SSH key login only, a firewall, automatic security updates, secrets kept out of Git, log rotation, a documented time zone, and a tested backup and restore.

Acceptance: Every check is pass/fail against a specific file or observable result. A stage is complete only when all its checks pass. Sign-off requires all checks to pass, a completed demo run on the VPS, and the handover session.

Out of scope (Phase 2): Monitoring and alerts, PDF reports, 1688 integration unless approved in week 1, automatic ordering or listing, and a web dashboard.

title: QA-тестирование GlinGo: задачи, время и оплаты
description:
Ищем QA-специалиста для исследовательского тестирования GlinGo — сервиса для клиентов, проектов, задач, учёта времени и денег. 
Предоставим отдельное тестовое пространство с готовыми данными и правами администратора этого пространства. Нужно проверить основные сценарии и пограничные случаи: где ломается логика, теряются изменения или интерфейс вводит в заблуждение. 
Что проверяем: 
• Создание, редактирование и удаление клиентов, проектов и задач. 
• Учёт времени и оплат. 
• Согласованность данных после изменений. 
• Обработку ошибок и понятность интерфейса. 
Бюджет — 20 000 ₽ за исполнителя. Ориентир — 4–5 часов вместе с отчётом, один десктопный браузер. Срок — 3 календарных дня после получения доступа. Сценарии согласуем перед началом. Нагрузочное тестирование, аудит безопасности и повторная проверка исправлений не входят. 
Результат: список проверенных сценариев и баг-репорты со шагами, ожидаемым и фактическим результатом, приоритетом, скриншотами или видео. Замечания по удобству — отдельно. 
Платим за выполненную проверку и содержательный отчёт независимо от количества багов. 
В отклике расскажите об опыте QA, укажите браузер и приложите пример баг-репорта без конфиденциальных данных. Доступ выдадим выбранному исполнителю. Бесплатного тестового задания нет.

title: Разработка VK-бота (SaaS) на Python (vkbottle) + Docker
description:
Ищу Python-разработчика для создания MVP чат-бота по готовому ТЗ. 
Это не просто «бот-визитка», а SaaS-платформа (мультитенантность), где один код обслуживает несколько салонов. Клиенты оставляют заявки на услуги, а владельцы бизнеса получают их в удобном виде. 
Стек: 
· Python 3.10+ 
· Библиотека для работы с мессенджером (vkbottle или aiogram) 
· SQLite 
· Обязательно: упаковка в Docker. 
Что нужно сделать (кратко): 
Бот разделяет пользователей по ссылкам на 3 роли: 
1. Супер-Админ (я): Вставляю токены, получаю ссылки для салонов. Могу включать/выключать бота (оплата подписки). 
2. Владелец салона: Настраивает название, добавляет услуги, принимает заявки, меняет аватарку. 
3. Клиент: Выбирает услугу, пишет имя и телефон. Заявка падает владельцу. 
Важно: Бот НЕ ведет календарь. Бот — это сборщик заявок. 
Условия сдачи: 
· Исходный код, Docker-файлы, короткая инструкция (readme) по запуску на VPS. 
· Бесплатное исправление багов в течение 3 дней после сдачи. 
· Приемка работы только после моего теста с двух аккаунтов. 
Внимание! Полное ТЗ со всеми деталями (база данных, кнопки, архитектура) я прикрепляю файлом ниже (в формате Word). Обязательно ознакомьтесь с ним перед откликом. 
В отклике напишите: 
1. Есть ли у вас опыт с этой библиотекой и Docker? 
2. Делали ли вы раньше ботов с разделением доступа (мультитенантность)? 
3. Ссылку на 1-2 ваших рабочих проекта.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужен MVP VK-бота на Python (vkbottle или aiogram) с мультитенантностью: один код обслуживает несколько салонов, есть три роли (супер-админ, владелец, клиент), бот собирает заявки без календаря. Упаковка в Docker, SQLite, сдача с readme для VPS и 3 дня бесплатных исправлений. Бюджет 10 000 ₽ невысокий для такого объёма.

title: Lovable and Supabase developer to complete an internal web app
description:
We are a UK construction consultancy with an internal web app for estimating and quoting. The core is already built and heavily tested, with over 1,800 automated tests. We need an experienced senior developer to finish the remaining features, tighten security and fix known bugs, so we can take a real job from a CSV take-off through to an issued quote.

This isn't a new build or a small bug-fix job. A cheap or junior bid is likely to break the calculation logic. Please only apply if you've shipped production React, TypeScript and Supabase apps with row-level security and are comfortable in a large, already-tested codebase.

Tech stack

- React, TypeScript and Tailwind, built in Lovable
- Supabase: Postgres, authentication, row-level security and edge functions
- Vitest, with over 1,800 tests that must stay green
- GitHub with two-way Lovable sync (it will be connected before you start); all work is reviewed before it's accepted

Current state
The estimating core exists: take-off import, cost building, a large catalogue, templates, a pricing matrix, supplier records, programme and preliminaries screens, a client portal, notes, and PDF and Excel export. Sign-up is already invite-only, and database access has been tightened. A full run of one real job and the remaining feature work are still outstanding.

Scope (fixed-price milestones)
A written brief with acceptance checks will go to the shortlisted freelancer once an NDA and IP assignment are signed. In outline:

1. Paid familiarisation, about one week: read the code, run the tests, and quote the milestones below.
2. Forgiving data import: accept typical CSV and Excel take-off files, match rows safely, and ask for confirmation rather than silently picking the wrong item.
3. One-click auto-build of preliminaries, including site costs generated from the programme.
4. Programme-driven recalculation: preliminaries and other time-based costs update when the programme changes.
5. Supplier enquiry and quote workflow: raise enquiries, record quotes, and keep unconfirmed prices out of the issued total.
6. Senior review and sign-off: a hold-point before a quote can be sent to the client.
7. Client portal: client project requests and a project tracker.
8. Linked drawings: uploaded drawings linked to the relevant quote items.
9. Security hardening: auth settings, storage and policy tidy-up, and validation so invalid quantities or costs can't quietly change a total.
10. Mobile layout: the navigation currently covers the screen at phone width.
11. Email delivery: invitations and status emails must reliably arrive.

Milestones 2 to 6 are the priority for a first usable version. The rest follow in the order we agree after the familiarisation week. You won't be asked to invent commercial rates or judge whether a price is right; that stays with us.

How we work

- An NDA and IP assignment are signed before the full brief or any code is shared, and everything you produce belongs to us.
- All work is done in a test environment with sample data. You won't have access to live commercial data, and you don't publish or deploy.
- Database changes are supplied as migration scripts for our review, never run against the live system.
- All existing tests must pass at every milestone, and agreed benchmark totals must stay unchanged.
- Fixed price per milestone, paid through PeoplePerHour.
- You'll need to overlap with UK working hours. UK-based is preferred.

To apply, please tell us:

1. Two Supabase projects you've worked on and what you built, especially anything with row-level security or a mature schema.
2. Whether you've worked on a Lovable-generated codebase before.
3. How you handle database changes on a system that's already in use.
4. Your availability, your overlap with UK hours, and whether you're UK-based.
5. How you'd break a job this size into milestones, and a ballpark price for the familiarisation week.

Applications that don't answer these questions won't be considered.

analysis.summary_ru: Британская строительная консалтинговая компания ищет senior-разработчика, чтобы доработать внутреннее веб-приложение для смет и КП на React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Lovable и Supabase: завершить оставшиеся функции, усилить безопасность и исправить баги, не сломав более 1800 тестов. Оплата фиксированная по этапам, требуется ответить на 5 вопросов в заявке.
analysis.reply:
Your core estimating app is already built and well tested, so the job is to finish milestones 2 to 6 without changing the validated calculation logic. I'd start with the paid familiarisation week: run the Vitest suite, trace the take-off-to-quote path, and confirm the milestone estimates. For the first usable version I'd build the CSV/Excel import with explicit match confirmation, then the programme-driven preliminaries and the supplier-quote hold-point. Each step would come as a reviewable GitHub change with its tests and a migration script.

On your questions: [Supabase projects with RLS and what I built]; [Lovable experience, yes or no, with details]; database changes go in versioned migrations for your review, never run against live data; availability [hours per week]; UK overlap [hours]; UK-based [yes/no]. Familiarisation week: [price].

See live demos at https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Ваше основное приложение для смет уже построено и хорошо покрыто тестами, поэтому задача — довести этапы 2–6 до конца, не меняя проверенную логику расчётов. Я бы начал с оплачиваемой недели ознакомления: запустил бы набор тестов Vitest, проследил путь от импорта обмера до КП и подтвердил оценки по этапам. Для первой рабочей версии я бы сделал импорт CSV/Excel с явным подтверждением сопоставления, затем автоматические предварительные затраты, связанные с графиком, и точку согласования для КП поставщиков. Каждый шаг пришёл бы как изменение в GitHub, которое можно проверить, с тестами и скриптом миграции.

 Senior Java Backend Engineer
*Location:* Remote
---
### About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on *Senior Java Backend Engineer* to design, build, and scale our core distributed systems and event-driven architecture. You will work closely with product and infrastructure teams to deliver high-performance microservices deployed on AWS, leveraging modern cloud-native tooling, real-time data streaming via Confluent Cloud, and robust automation testing practices.
---
### Key Responsibilities
* *Design & Development:* Build scalable, resilient, and secure microservices using *Java and Spring Boot*.
* *Event-Driven Architecture:* Implement real-time data streaming and asynchronous messaging pipelines using *Apache Kafka* and *Confluent Cloud*, alongside traditional message queues.
* *Infrastructure & Deployment:* Manage cloud infrastructure on *AWS* using *Terraform* for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including configuring Kubernetes manifests, environment variables, and *ConfigMaps*.
* *Quality & Automation:* Drive engineering excellence by writing comprehensive automated test suites using *Cucumber (BDD)* and JUnit, ensuring high test coverage and reliability.
* *Collaboration:* Participate in code reviews, system design discussions, and CI/CD pipeline optimization in an Agile environment.
---
### Required Skills & Qualifications
* *Core Engineering:* 3+ years of robust software development experience with strong proficiency in *Java 17+* and the *Spring Boot* ecosystem.
* *Streaming & Messaging:* Deep hands-on experience with *Apache Kafka, schema registries, consumer/producer tuning, and managed Kafka platforms like **Confluent Cloud*. Familiarity with other message queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, AWS SQS) is a strong plus.
* *Cloud & DevOps:* Proven experience deploying and managing production workloads on *AWS* (ECS, EKS, RDS, IAM, S3).
* *Infrastructure as Code:* Strong command over *Terraform, managing cloud resources, modular configurations, and Kubernetes **ConfigMaps* / secrets management.
* *Testing:* Demonstrated experience building BDD-based automated test frameworks using *Cucumber* integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* *Mindset:* Strong first-principles problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a focus on clean, maintainable code architecture.

title: Property Finance Power BI Dashboard
description:
I want a single, well-structured Power BI dashboard that lets me review our overall property-management income and expenses at a glance. All source data will arrive as Excel or CSV files that I can refresh weekly, so please design the model and queries with that workflow in mind—no direct connections to online systems are needed.

The dashboard must surface property profit, cash flow, and budget-versus-actual performance for each building in my portfolio. I should be able to slice the visuals by property, period, and expense or revenue category, then drill down to the underlying transaction lines when I spot a variance.

Key deliverables:
• Clean, documented Power Query steps that import and transform the raw spreadsheets. 
• A star-schema data model with measures for profit, operating cash flow, and budget variance. 
• An interactive report page (or pages) in a .pbix file that includes dynamic cards, waterfall or column charts, and a summary table, all formatted to our corporate colours. 
• A short PDF or video walkthrough showing how to refresh the data and extend the model with new properties.

I will provide sample Excel exports and a field dictionary once we start. If something in the source layout needs tweaking for automation, flag it early so we can adjust.
