title: Technical Account Manager for SaaS
description:
About the role
We're hiring a Technical Account Manager to own our customer relationships so our engineers can stay focused on building. Our engineering team handles the technology. You'll be the person customers trust day to day, and the person engineers rely on to bring them clear, prioritized, well-scoped customer needs.
You'll sit between customers and engineering. You translate business problems into technical requests, keep accounts healthy and growing, and shield the team from ad-hoc interruptions without hiding what customers really need.
Location: [Remote / Hybrid / City] · Reports to: [Head of Engineering / CEO] · Type: Full-time
What you'll do
Own the customer relationship
Be the main point of contact for a portfolio of customer accounts, from onboarding through renewal.
Run regular check-ins and quarterly business reviews to understand goals, usage and risks.
Build trust with stakeholders on the customer side, from day-to-day users to executive sponsors.
Be the bridge to engineering
Turn customer requests, bugs and feedback into clear, well-scoped tickets that engineers can act on without a follow-up meeting.
Triage incoming issues: resolve what you can, escalate what you can't, and set honest expectations on timelines.
Join technical calls with engineers when needed, and keep customers informed during incidents.
Share themes from across accounts with engineering and product to shape the roadmap.
Keep accounts healthy and growing
Track account health and spot churn risk early.
Drive adoption of features customers already pay for.
Identify expansion opportunities and support renewals and upsells.
Build the process
Set up how customer requests flow to engineering, including intake, prioritization and status updates.
Maintain account notes, documentation and a help-center or FAQ so the same questions don't reach engineers twice.
What you'll bring
3+ years in account management, customer success or a similar customer-facing role at a software or SaaS company.
Enough technical fluency to follow an engineering conversation, read an API doc or log, and write a bug report an engineer can reproduce. You don't need to write code.
Clear, calm communication, in writing and on calls, including when the news is bad.
Sound judgment on what to escalate, what to handle yourself, and what to push back on.
Strong organization: you can juggle many accounts and requests without dropping threads.
Comfort with tools like a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce), a ticketing system (Jira, Linear) and shared docs.
Nice to have
Experience as a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer or Support Engineer.
Background in our industry or with customers like ours: [industry].
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, SQL or cloud platforms.
Experience building customer-success processes at an early-stage company.

• Tech – feel free to use WordPress, Webflow, or a lightweight custom build; what matters is mobile-first performance, SEO-ready code, and easy content editing.

title: Build AI Amazon or Walmart Product Research MVP - Ai Agent
description:
Summary of the Freelancer job post: AI Amazon Product Research Agent (MVP)
*********Please see the attached files for the complete project ********************

What the client wants: A Python agent that finds Amazon products suitable for importing from China. It builds candidate lists, scores products, checks Google Trends, finds Alibaba suppliers, and calculates profit under normal and stressed conditions. It runs on a Linux cloud VPS on a schedule, and it only recommends. A human approves every purchase, supplier contact, and listing.

Hard rules:

No scraping Amazon. Use licensed sources only: Keepa, Jungle Scout or Helium 10, and Amazon SP-API.

Production runs on a Linux VPS, not a personal computer or shared hosting.

The developer builds everything from scratch in a new repository. The reference files are not a codebase to build on and do not override the post.

Timeline: 2 weeks (10 working days)

Budget: Pricing is based on the bidder’s proposed amount. Bidders should not ask for the client’s budget.

Stages: 0. Access and server setup (Days 1–2): Provision and harden the VPS, test each data source from the server, and document access.

Candidate list builder (Days 2–5): Pull the top 100 items per category for 5 categories, deduplicate by ASIN, and group into niches. Deliverable: candidates.csv.

Filters and scoring (Days 2–5): Apply hard exclusions, score products on weighted metrics, and rank them with source and date for every metric. Deliverable: ranked_products.xlsx.

Google Trends (Days 7–8): Analyze the top 10 finalists for slope and seasonality, with charts. Deliverables: trend_scores.csv, trends_report.xlsx, charts/.

Supplier finder (Days 7–8): Collect the top 3 Alibaba suppliers per finalist and flag risks. Deliverable: suppliers.csv.

Profit calculator (Days 6–7, re-run after Stage 4): Calculate landed cost, fees, and net profit, with four stress scenarios. Deliverable: profit_model.xlsx.

title: Spreadsheet Data Cleaning & Formatting

Рабочий MVP с задачами, ролями, фильтрами и экспортом можно подготовить примерно за 2–3 недели, а на первом этапе будет тестовый URL. title: Tally API Integration for Invoice, E-Invoice & E-Way Bill Data
description:

Requirements:

Odoo will handle all invoice creation and E-Invoice and E-Way Bill generation.
We will provide invoice and related data from Odoo through APIs.
Tally customization is required only to receive and store the data coming from Odoo.
Develop custom Tally code to fetch and import API data into Tally.
Ensure proper field mapping and data synchronization.
Deploy and configure the customized Tally code on our live server.

Looking for an experienced Tally customization developer with strong knowledge of Tally integration, TDL, and API connectivity.

analysis.reply:
You need Odoo to push invoices, E-Invoice and E-Way Bill data into Tally, with the Tally side receiving, storing and mapping the fields, deployed on your live server. On the API side I would define the payload schema, map the Odoo invoice fields to Tally voucher fields, and add retry-safe sync so records aren't duplicated, with logging for every transfer. My rough estimate is 1–2 weeks for the API layer and mapping, plus a few days for deployment and testing.

Two questions: which Tally version and edition are you running, and do you already have Odoo API access and sample payloads? Also, does the budget cover the full scope including server deployment?

title: Website Order-Handling Claude Chatbot
description:
I want to embed a Claude-powered chat widget on my website that guides visitors through the full order and booking flow. The bot’s core job is to handle everything after a customer clicks “chat”, from checking an existing order or reservation, to creating or modifying a new one, and even cancelling when requested. Every reply should feel conversational yet precise, drawing on Claude’s language skills while staying tightly aligned with my fulfilment rules and database. 

Here is what I need from you: 
• A conversational flow for three scenarios—status lookup, create/change, and cancellation—mapped to the endpoints of my order-management API. 
• Front-end widget code that drops straight into my site (vanilla JS or React is fine) and hands the conversation off to Claude’s API. 
• Web-hook or middleware logic that translates user intent into the correct API call, then pushes the response back to the chat in plain language. 
• Clear setup notes so I can update intents, keys, or UI text without touching core code. 

Acceptance is simple: I should be able to open my staging site, ask “Where’s my order #1234?”, “Book me a table for four at 7 pm”, or “Cancel last week’s reservation”, and see the chatbot complete each request end-to-end without manual intervention. 

I am a Digital Communication graduate from CEU San Pablo University and have completed a master's degree in Big Data and Artificial Intelligence at the same institution. My professional profile stands at the intersection of creativity and logic. I combine the storytelling and strategic skills of a communicator with a solid technical background in programming, statistics, and data analysis. Throughout my professional career across diverse sectors, I have developed strong expertise in digital community management, content creation, and data-driven optimization. Beyond traditional digital marketing, I specialize in cutting-edge Generative AI production and AI-powered development. I build custom websites and interactive web applications using vibe coding workflows, and I design AI agents to automate processes and enhance digital strategies. Furthermore, I master a wide ecosystem of generative AI platforms and models—including Magnific AI, Higgsfield, and leading image, video, and voice synthesis tools—to produce high-impact visual assets and full-scale AI commercials. I do not just create content; I analyze its performance to apply a strategic approach that improves ROI and project outcomes. I thrive in multidisciplinary teams and am deeply motivated to continue growing in the field of Big Data and AI, contributing value through innovation, rigorous analysis, and creative problem-solving.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик хочет встроить на сайт чат-виджет на базе Claude API, который обрабатывает заказы и бронирования: проверку статуса, создание и изменение, отмену. Бот должен преобразовывать запросы пользователя в вызовы его API управления заказами и возвращать понятные ответы, включая виджет, middleware и настройку интентов без изменения основного кода.
analysis.reply:
You want a Claude-powered widget that takes a visitor from "chat" to a finished action: checking an order or reservation, creating or changing one, and cancelling. I'd build it as a lightweight vanilla JS widget plus a small middleware layer. Claude would detect the intent and extract details like order number, party size, or time. The middleware would map those to your order-management endpoints and turn the responses into plain-language replies. Intents, endpoint mappings, API keys, and UI strings would sit in a config file, so you can update them without touching core code. I estimate about 7–10 days to a working staging build, including end-to-end testing of all three scenarios.

Check out live demos in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Two questions: do your endpoints need a per-customer auth token, and how should the bot verify identity before it shows or cancels an order?

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужен чат-виджет на базе Claude, который проводит посетителя от нажатия «чат» до готового действия: проверка заказа или брони, создание и изменение, отмена. Я бы сделал лёгкий виджет на vanilla JS и небольшой middleware-слой. Claude определяет интент и извлекает детали, например номер заказа, количество гостей или время. Middleware сопоставляет их с эндпоинтами вашего API управления заказами и переводит ответы в понятный текст. Интенты, сопоставление эндпоинтов, API-ключи и тексты интерфейса будут в конфигурационном файле, так что их можно менять без правки основного кода. Ориентировочный срок до рабочей сборки на staging, включая сквозное тестирование всех трёх сценариев, — 7–10 дней.

title: Fractional CSO - B2B Sales Leader
description:
Fractional Sales Manager — B2B Business Development

Company: Snack Hive
Location: Portland, OR / Seattle, WA Metropolitan Areas
Commitment: Part-time, 10–15 hours per week
Compensation: Monthly retainer + performance-based incentives
Engagement: Initial 90-day engagement with long-term growth opportunities

About Snack Hive

Snack Hive is a growing workplace vending and micro-market solutions provider delivering modern, cashless, and customizable refreshment services to businesses.

We help businesses improve their employee experience through personalized product selections, responsive local service, and convenient access to snacks and beverages without the operational burden of managing vending equipment.

As we expand across the Pacific Northwest, we’re looking for an experienced Fractional Sales Manager to lead, develop, and scale our sales organization.

About the Opportunity

We’re seeking a results-driven sales leader who can take ownership of our sales operations, develop a high-performing sales team, and establish a scalable, repeatable customer acquisition process.

This is a hands-on leadership position combining sales strategy, team management, coaching, and revenue generation. The ideal candidate understands how to build and manage a sales organization within a growing business.

You will work directly with company leadership and have access to an established prospect database, CRM infrastructure, sales resources, and operational support.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Leadership and Team Development

* Recruit, interview, onboard, and develop sales representatives.
* Manage the day-to-day performance of the sales team.
* Establish individual and team sales targets.
* Conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, and sales training.
* Develop and refine sales scripts, objection-handling techniques, and closing strategies.
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action plans.
* Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and results.

Sales Strategy and Operations

* Develop and execute a scalable B2B customer acquisition strategy.
* Oversee outbound prospecting, lead qualification, and customer acquisition activities.
* Manage and optimize our HubSpot CRM and sales pipeline.
* Establish standardized sales processes and operating procedures.
* Monitor conversion rates, pipeline health, and sales productivity.
* Develop accurate sales forecasts and performance reports.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition costs and sales efficiency.

Business Development

* Support sales representatives in closing high-value and complex opportunities.
* Develop relationships with key decision-makers and strategic accounts.
* Identify multi-location placement and customer expansion opportunities.
* Establish referral and strategic partnership channels.
* Coordinate with operations to ensure successful customer onboarding and equipment installation.

Target Customers

* Corporate offices
* Warehouses and distribution centers
* Manufacturing facilities
* Apartment communities
* Hotels
* Fitness centers
* Automotive service centers
* Commercial properties
* Multi-location businesses

Compensation and Benefits

* Monthly retainer.
* Performance-based incentives tied to overall team sales results.
* Additional earning opportunities based on revenue growth and successful machine placements.
* Uncapped performance-based earning potential.
* Flexible working hours.
* Established CRM, prospect database, and sales infrastructure.
* Opportunity to transition into a long-term senior sales leadership position.
* Direct collaboration with company leadership and influence over the direction of the sales organization.

Qualifications

* Minimum of five years of B2B sales experience.
* Minimum of two years of sales management or team leadership experience.
* Demonstrated ability to recruit, coach, and develop sales representatives.
* Proven track record of achieving team revenue and sales targets.
* Experience building or scaling outbound sales teams.
* Strong understanding of consultative selling and customer acquisition strategies.
* Experience managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and performance metrics.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms, preferably HubSpot.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Ability to operate independently in a growing, entrepreneurial environment.

Experience working with startups, small businesses, or commission-based sales teams is preferred.

Previous vending industry experience is not required.

Performance Expectations

Success will be measured by tangible business outcomes, including:

* Monthly team sales and placement targets.
* Successfully installed and active vending machines.
* Sales representative productivity and conversion rates.
* Sales team recruitment, development, and retention.
* Customer acquisition costs.
* Revenue growth and pipeline forecasting accuracy.
* Development of a scalable and repeatable sales process.

The initial 90-day engagement will be evaluated based on measurable team performance, sales growth, and the effectiveness of the sales processes implemented.

Who This Role Is For

This opportunity is ideal for an experienced sales manager, fractional sales leader, or independent sales consultant who enjoys building teams and developing sales organizations without committing to a traditional full-time position.

We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of the sales function, operate with minimal oversight, and turn business growth objectives into measurable results.

How to Apply

Please provide a brief introduction outlining:

* Your B2B sales and sales management experience.
* Examples of sales teams you have built, managed, or scaled.
* Measurable results you have achieved in previous leadership positions.
* Your availability and compensation expectations.

Learn more: https://snackhives.com

title: E-commerce Chat Response Specialist
description:
Project title
Virtual Assistant for a UK Online Furniture and Flooring Store: Customer Chat, Orders and Deliveries

Description

About us
Aurino & Co is a UK online store (aurino.co.uk) selling furniture, flooring, wall panels, rugs and home décor. We're a small business. I'm looking for a reliable virtual assistant to take over the day-to-day customer service and order handling, so I can focus on growing the business. This is a long-term role for the right person.

What you'll do

1. Customer chats and messages

Reply to website chat conversations that our system hands over to a person. You'll do this from our internal dashboard.
Spot customers who are close to buying, for example people asking about stock, sizes, colours, delivery dates or prices. Help them decide with clear answers, the right product links and a follow-up.
Contact customers by email, phone or WhatsApp about their orders and questions.
2. Supplier orders

When a customer orders, place the order with the right supplier.
Chase order confirmations, stock levels and dispatch dates.
When the supplier's invoice arrives, pass it to me. I pay all invoices, so you won't handle any payments.
3. Deliveries

Upload orders to our delivery partners' platforms.
Track every order until it reaches the customer, and keep the tracking on each order up to date.
Handle delays, failed deliveries and damage reports. Keep the customer informed and sort out the problem with the supplier or courier.
4. Reviews

After delivery, check in with customers and ask happy ones for a review.
Tell me about any unhappy customer straight away, before it turns into a bad review.
Who we're looking for

Excellent written English. Our customers are UK homeowners, so your tone should be friendly, clear and professional.
Experience in ecommerce customer service, order processing or virtual assistant work. 
Very organised. Every order should be tracked from start to finish, with nothing missed.
Confident with sales: you can tell when someone is ready to buy and help them without being pushy.
Quick replies to chats during working hours.
Your own computer and a reliable internet connection.
Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement, because you'll see customer names, addresses and order details.
Hours and pay

 hours per week to start, 3 days, 10am - 1pm UK time.
Paid hourly. More hours are available as the business grows.
Start date: asap.
How to apply
Start your bid with the word "Delivered" so I know you've read this post. Then tell me:

Your experience with ecommerce customer service and order handling.
The hours you can work, in UK time.
How you would reply to this customer chat: "Hi, is the grey corner sofa in stock, and could I get it before the end of the year?"
Bids that don't answer these three points won't be considered.

title: Βελτίωση εικόνων σε WordPress Elementor -- 2
description:
Σχετικά με το project
Έχω την Boothflix (boothflix.gr), επιχείρηση ενοικίασης photobooth για γάμους, βαπτίσεις και εταιρικές εκδηλώσεις. Το site είναι φτιαγμένο σε WordPress/Elementor. Ψάχνω έμπειρο freelancer για να ανανεώσει την αρχική σελίδα, να προσθέσει νέες σελίδες και να στήσει τη συμμόρφωση με GDPR, το SEO και τις μετρήσεις. Θα δώσω σχέδιο (mockup), όλα τα κείμενα και δικές μου φωτογραφίες.

Εργασίες

 1. Αρχική σελίδα (νέα δομή)
• Το hero με το βίντεο στο φόντο μένει όπως είναι, με μικρές διορθώσεις.
• Ενότητα εκδηλώσεων (Γάμος, Βάπτιση, Εταιρικά) σε μικρότερα πλαίσια με δικές μου φωτογραφίες.
• 6 κάρτες υπηρεσιών (Mirror, Retro, 360°, Video Wish Phone, Wish Phone, Wish Booth).
• Πλέγμα φωτογραφιών από το Instagram, κριτικές πελατών, συχνές ερωτήσεις.
 2. Νέες σελίδες
• Μία σελίδα για κάθε υπηρεσία (6), με φωτογραφία, περιγραφή και «Τι περιλαμβάνει».
• Σελίδες για Γάμο, Βάπτιση, Εταιρικές εκδηλώσεις, Photobooth Αθήνα και Συχνές ερωτήσεις.
 3. Κουμπί «Πάρε προσφορά»
• Κυκλικό κουμπί σταθερό κάτω δεξιά σε όλες τις σελίδες, που ανοίγει φόρμα επικοινωνίας σε popup. Τα μηνύματα έρχονται στο email μου.
• Κουμπιά Κλήσης και WhatsApp.
 4. Διορθώσεις στο υπάρχον site
• Να φύγουν οι τόνοι από τα κεφαλαία.
• Αντικατάσταση των stock φωτογραφιών με δικές μου, ενιαίες γραμματοσειρές, διόρθωση μενού και footer, μικρές οπτικές διορθώσεις.
 5. GDPR
• Cookie banner με ισότιμα κουμπιά «Αποδοχή / Απόρριψη», σύμφωνα με τις οδηγίες της Αρχής Προστασίας Δεδομένων (ΑΠΔΠΧ), με Google Consent Mode v2. Τα εργαλεία της Google να φορτώνουν μόνο μετά τη συγκατάθεση.
• Σελίδα Πολιτικής απορρήτου & cookies και σύντομο σημείωμα κάτω από τη φόρμα.
 6. SEO και μετρήσεις
• SEO τίτλοι και meta descriptions, sitemap, Google Search Console, συμπίεση εικόνων, 301 redirects για όσα URLs αλλάζουν.

Απαιτήσεις
• Αποδεδειγμένη εμπειρία σε WordPress και Elementor (με παραδείγματα από sites που είναι online).
• Εμπειρία με plugins συγκατάθεσης cookies (π.χ. Complianz, CookieYes) και Google Consent Mode v2.
• Βασικές γνώσεις SEO.
• Το site να δείχνει τέλεια στο κινητό (mobile-first).

Παραδοτέα
• Όλες οι αλλαγές ανεβασμένες στο site και ελεγμένες σε κινητό και υπολογιστή.
• Backup του site πριν και μετά τις αλλαγές.
• Λίστα με τα redirects που έγιναν.
• Σύντομες οδηγίες για να μπορώ να αλλάζω μόνος μου φωτογραφίες και κείμενα.

title: Pembantu Khidmat Pelanggan Sambilan
description:
Saya memerlukan seseorang yang boleh bekerja secara sambilan sebagai pembantu khidmat pelanggan. Tugas utama anda ialah menjawab mesej, menyelesaikan pertanyaan asas dan memastikan setiap pelanggan berasa didengari serta dibantu.

Apa yang perlu anda lakukan
• Pantau saluran mesej (e-mail, WhatsApp Business, Facebook Messenger) dan balas dalam tempoh satu jam semasa syif anda. 
• Gunakan skrip jawapan sedia ada untuk soalan lazim dan kemas kini skrip apabila perlu. 
• Kumpul maklum balas pelanggan, kenal pasti isu berulang dan laporkan kepada saya pada akhir hari. 
• Rekodkan setiap interaksi dalam Google Sheets atau Zendesk bagi tujuan penjejakan.

Keperluan asas
• Fasih berbahasa Melayu; kebolehan berbahasa Inggeris dikira sebagai nilai tambah. 
• Pengalaman atau minat dalam khidmat pelanggan—anda selesa berkomunikasi secara sopan dan profesional. 
• Akses Internet yang stabil dan peranti sendiri (telefon atau komputer). 
• Boleh komited sekurang-kurangnya 4 jam sehari, lima hari seminggu.

Kriteria kejayaan
• Kadar tindak balas ≤1 jam semasa syif. 
• Skor kepuasan pelanggan ≥90% (akan dinilai melalui borang ringkas). 
• Laporan ringkas dihantar pada penghujung setiap syif.

Sertakan ringkasan pengalaman berkaitan, alat yang pernah anda gunakan (contohnya Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom) dan jadual masa yang anda boleh komited. Saya menantikan kerjasama anda untuk memastikan setiap pelanggan berasa dihargai.

title: Live Multi City Inventory Dashboard
description:
I keep all warehouse inventory in a single Google Sheet and want that data to flow into a cloud-based dashboard that updates the moment the sheet changes. The goal is simple: everyone—from employees on the floor to management and resellers—should be able to see what is in stock without touching the spreadsheet.

The dashboard must display multiple-warehouse visibility, brand- and product-level views, SKU snapshots, and a combined total that can still be broken down to show ready stock in Delhi and Mumbai. Customers will log in to view only the quantities reserved for them, while staff and management enjoy broader access. Every report needs an “Export to Excel” button, and the entire interface has to be mobile-friendly for quick checks on phones.

I am open to the tool you prefer—Google Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, or a lightweight custom web app—provided it reads directly from the Google Sheet and refreshes instantly when I change a cell. Authentication can be Google sign-in or a simple role-based password system; whichever is fastest to manage.

Deliverables 
• Live dashboard URL with employee, reseller, customer, and management roles pre-configured 
• Automated sync script or connector tied to the Google Sheet (no manual refresh) 
• Excel download option on each report view 
• Short handover guide covering user management and basic layout edits 

Acceptance: during a quick screen-share I will edit a value in the Google Sheet and watch it update on all relevant dashboard tiles—including the combined total and individual Delhi/Mumbai figures—within seconds.

analysis.summary_ru: Облачный дашборд складских остатков, который читает данные из одной Google-таблицы и обновляется сразу после изменений. Нужны роли (сотрудники, реселлеры, клиенты, менеджмент), разбивка по Дели и Мумбаи, экспорт в Excel и мобильная версия.
analysis.reply:
You want warehouse stock from one Google Sheet to appear on a live dashboard for staff, resellers, customers and management, with per-city totals for Delhi and Mumbai, Excel export, and a phone-friendly layout. I'd build a lightweight custom web app rather than a BI tool, because per-customer reserved quantities and role-based views are easier to control that way. The sheet would connect through the Google Sheets API with a service account, and an Apps Script edit trigger would push changes to the backend so every tile refreshes within seconds. Login would use Google sign-in or role-based passwords, whichever you prefer. I estimate about 10–14 days for a working version, including the handover guide.

Live demos are in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Could you share the column layout of the sheet (warehouse, brand, SKU, reserved-for-customer)? And do you need Google sign-in, or are role-based passwords fine?

Yakov
analysis.reply_ru:
Вам нужно, чтобы остатки со склада из одной Google-таблицы появлялись на живом дашборде для сотрудников, реселлеров, клиентов и менеджмента, с итогами по Дели и Мумбаи, экспортом в Excel и удобной версией для телефона. Я бы сделал легковесное собственное веб-приложение, а не BI-инструмент, потому что резервы по каждому клиенту и представления по ролям так легче контролировать. Таблица подключалась бы через Google Sheets API с сервисным аккаунтом, а триггер Apps Script при каждом изменении отправлял бы данные на бэкенд, чтобы все плитки обновлялись в течение нескольких секунд. Вход можно сделать через Google или по паролям для каждой роли, на ваш выбор. Оценка: около 10–14 дней на рабочую версию, включая гайд по передаче.

title: Coaching websites
description:
To get accurate bids and avoid scope creep on a freelancer platform, organize your post around **segmented tracks** (Olympiads, Class 6–10 Foundation, NEET, and IIT JEE) and **core functional modules** (live classes, recordings, notes, payments, student dashboard, test dashboard, and admin controls).

A complete project brief you can copy and paste into your freelancer job post follows below, along with practical tips for hiring and structuring milestones.

---

## Ready-to-Post Freelancer Project Brief

> **Project Title:** Multi-Track Online Coaching & Test Series Website (Olympiads, Class 6–10 Foundation, NEET & IIT JEE)
> **Overview:**
> I am looking for an experienced full-stack web developer or agency to build a responsive online coaching and test platform for four distinct academic verticals: **Olympiads**, **Basic Foundation (Classes 6–10)**, **NEET**, and **IIT JEE**. Each vertical must operate as a clearly separated learning track with its own courses, batches, schedules, study materials, and tests, while sharing a unified user account and payment system.
> **1. Four Separated Academic Verticals**
> * **Olympiads Track:** Subject/exam-wise batches and practice resources.
> * **Foundation Track (Classes 6–10):** Class-wise and subject-wise batches aligned with school fundamentals.
> * **NEET Track:** Physics, Chemistry, and Biology batches, test series, and revision modules.
> * **IIT JEE Track:** Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics batches (Main/Advanced structure), test series, and practice sets.
> * Students must be able to filter by vertical, class/target year, and batch, and only access content unlocked by their active enrollment.
> 
> 
> **2. Live Classes & Recorded Lectures**
> * **Live Lectures:** Batch-wise class schedule/timetable, join-class links or embedded live stream integration (e.g., Zoom/YouTube Live/Vimeo/WebRTC/streaming SDK), attendance or join tracking, and real-time or scheduled doubt support.
> * **Recorded Lectures:** Auto-archived or uploaded class recordings organized by vertical, batch, subject, and chapter, with playback speed controls, quality options, watch-progress tracking, and basic screen-recording/piracy deterrents (such as dynamic user watermarking and restricted direct downloads).
> 
> 
> **3. Notes & Study Material Access**
> * Chapter-wise PDF notes, class slides, DPPs (Daily Practice Problems), and assignments mapped to each batch.
> * In-browser PDF viewer with controlled download permissions (downloadable vs. view-only based on course settings).
> 
> 
> **4. Payment Gateway & Enrollment**
> * Checkout supporting UPI, cards, net banking, and wallets (e.g., Razorpay/Stripe/Cashfree as appropriate for your region), plus coupon/discount codes, course validity dates, automatic access activation upon successful payment, and downloadable/viewable payment receipts.
> 
> 
> **5. Student Dashboard**
> * Enrolled batches across verticals, upcoming live classes, recently watched recordings, bookmarked notes/questions, course expiry/validity status, profile settings, and overall progress summary.
> 
> 
> **6. Test Dashboard & Assessment Engine**

title: Company Canteen App Development
description:
I’m looking for a developer who can turn our in-house canteen into a smooth, self-service experience. The app is strictly for our company canteen, so the audience is limited to employees and the kitchen staff who manage their orders and stock.

Core needs
Employees must be able to open the app, check canteen “sheets” (our term for the daily meal breakdown) and completely fill in any required selections before they arrive at the counter. Think of it as a quick snapshot: what’s cooking, what’s left, and what I’ve already reserved. On the staff side the same data should update in real time so they know exactly what still has to be prepared or restocked.

How I picture the workflow
• Staff publish the day’s menu and quantities from an admin panel. 
• Employees view that sheet, make their choices, and lock them in so nothing is over-promised. 
• Any change in those sheets—an item running low, an order cancelled—reflects instantly for both sides. 

A lightweight payment module or an easy gateway hook is a plus, but the immediate priority is getting the sheet-checking and full-fill process running flawlessly.

Deliverables
• Cross-platform mobile app (Android + iOS) and a small web dashboard. 
• Well-structured source code, database schema and installation guide. 
• Brief hand-off session so our IT team can maintain future menu uploads.

If you’ve built ordering or inventory tools before—especially with React Native, Flutter, or a modern web stack—let’s talk. I value clean code, clear documentation, and a quick turnaround.

title: Проектирование корзины и заказа интернет магазина UX/UI
description:
Сайт https://rippo.ru/ 
Требуется разработает логику взаимодействия покупателя с корзиной и оформлением заказа, расположение блоков и внешний вид страниц для компьютера и телефона. 
Задачи: 
- Проанализировать существующий интерфейс и предложить более понятный сценарий покупки. 
- Спроектировать корзину: товары, количество, удаление, скидки, промокод, итоговая сумма. 
- Спроектировать оформление: контакты, адрес, доставка СДЭК/Почтой России, оплата через Т‑Банк и при получении. 
- Предусмотреть подсказки, ошибки, ожидание расчёта доставки и подтверждение заказа. 
- Сделать прозрачными стоимость товаров, доставки, комиссии и суммы к оплате сейчас и при получении. 
- Сохранить стиль сайта и удобство мобильной версии. 
Результат работы: 
- Краткий UX-аудит: 3–5 основных проблем. 
- Согласованные схемы корзины и оформления. 
- Редактируемые макеты в Figma для компьютера и телефона, включая основные состояния и ошибки. 
- Кликабельный прототип и краткое описание поведения элементов, полей и правил адаптации. 
- Исходник .fig и экспорт макетов в PDF. 
Программирование и внедрение не требуются. Техническую диагностику и реализацию выполняем самостоятельно. Проектируем для существующей CMS без изменения её ядра. Логику и внешний вид необходимо согласовать с заказчиком до подготовки окончательных макетов. 
Обязательное условие отклика — ссылка на действующий интернет-магазин с реализованной корзиной и оформлением заказа, над которыми вы работали. Одной ссылки на макет в Figma недостаточно.

title: Fix WordPress Indexing & Errors
description:
My WordPress site is suffering from search-engine visibility problems: critical pages never make it into the XML sitemap and Google Search Console keeps flagging them as “Discovered – currently not indexed.” Before anything else, I want this crawling and indexing issue resolved, then we can move on to the other technical faults already piling up.

Here is the full scope of what I need:

• Investigate and repair whatever is preventing those key pages from reaching the sitemap and being picked up by bots. This may include correcting robots.txt directives, tweaking Yoast/Rank Math settings, and regenerating a clean XML sitemap. 
• Run manual, database-level troubleshooting—phpMyAdmin or WP-CLI is fine—to track down orphaned records or mis-assigned post_status values that could be hiding pages from crawlers. 
• Eliminate 4xx errors, broken internal links, and rogue 3xx chains that dilute crawl budget. 
• Trim oversized CSS files, enable minification, and compress large images (WebP preferred) so page weight no longer slows down indexing. 
• Repair or redirect orphan pages and update internal linking so nothing valuable sits stranded. 
• Deliver a short report summarising every fix, the tools used (Search Console, Screaming Frog, WP-Optimize, etc.), and before/after evidence.

Acceptance criteria 
– Search Console shows zero “Excluded by noindex” or “Discovered – not indexed” for target pages. 
– XML sitemap lists all required pages and submits successfully. 
– No 4xx or unnecessary 3xx responses on a fresh crawl. 
– Core Web Vitals improve or remain stable after optimisation work.

Please send a detailed project proposal explaining how you will tackle each bullet. Links to similar repair jobs or concise case studies are welcome; I care more about a clear action plan than a long résumé.

analysis.summary_ru: Нужно исправить индексацию WordPress-сайта: ключевые страницы не попадают в XML-карту сайта и висят в статусе «Discovered – not indexed». Также нужно убрать 4xx и лишние 3xx, оптимизировать CSS и изображения, восстановить орфан-страницы и сделать отчёт. Объём большой, а бюджет всего 30 CAD.
analysis.reply:
Hi, thanks for the detailed brief. The core problem seems to be that key pages aren't reaching crawlers, so I'd start there: check robots.txt, noindex flags and post_status values in the database, then fix the Yoast/Rank Math settings, regenerate a clean sitemap and resubmit it in Search Console. After that I'd crawl the site with Screaming Frog to find 4xx errors, redirect chains and orphan pages, then minify CSS and convert images to WebP to improve page speed. You'd get a short report with before/after evidence. The indexing fix can start within a day and should be done in about 3–4 days. Two questions: which pages are the critical ones, and will I have admin and hosting access?

Portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/resume/

Yakov

Здравствуйте, спасибо за подробное описание. Основная проблема, похоже, в том, что ключевые страницы не доходят до поисковых роботов, поэтому я бы начал с них: проверил бы robots.txt, флаги noindex и значения post_status в базе данных, затем поправил бы настройки Yoast/Rank Math, пересоздал чистую карту сайта и отправил её повторно в Search Console. После этого я бы просканировал сайт в Screaming Frog, чтобы найти ошибки 4xx, цепочки редиректов и орфан-страницы, а затем минифицировал CSS и перевёл изображения в WebP для ускорения страниц. Вы получите короткий отчёт с доказательствами «до» и «после». Исправление индексации можно начать в течение дня, и обычно это занимает около 3–4 дней. title: Compliant Bulk People Search Platform
description:
Bulk People Search & Data Management Application
Project Overview
I'm looking for an experienced Python or full-stack developer to build a professional web-based application that automates bulk people-search workflows using authorized data sources and approved integrations.

FastPeopleSearch is my preferred reference source for this project.

The application should allow users to submit up to 500 records at once, process searches automatically, organize available results, and export the collected information into downloadable CSV files.

1. Bulk Input System
Accept up to 500 records per batch.
Allow users to paste multiple names directly into the application.
Each record should contain a person's name and city or state.
Support CSV file uploads.
Automatically validate entries and identify duplicates.
2. FastPeopleSearch Integration
Evaluate integration options with FastPeopleSearch.
Use authorized access methods and permitted integrations.
Investigate whether automated searches are supported.
Identify available data fields and integration limitations.
If direct integration is unavailable, recommend a suitable authorized alternative.
Ensure all integrations comply with applicable service terms and privacy requirements.
3. Automated Search Processing
Process submitted records automatically.
Support background processing.
Display real-time progress through a progress bar.
Show completed, pending, and unsuccessful searches.
Include error handling and retry functionality.
Allow users to monitor processing without refreshing the page.
4. Search Results Dashboard
Display results in an organized table.
Group results according to the original input records.
Display available and authorized information.
Include source attribution and match confidence.
Allow users to review individual search results.
5. Data Export
Export completed results into CSV format.
Allow users to copy results directly from the dashboard.
Support downloading batch results.
Preserve the relationship between submitted records and returned results.
6. Application Interface
Clean, modern, user-friendly interface.
Simple input and search workflow.
Live processing status.
Search history.
Ability to review previous batches.
7. Technical Preferences
Python with FastAPI for the backend.
React for the frontend.

Playwright where permitted by the relevant service provider.

Windows-compatible deployment.

8. Compliance Requirements
All integrations and automated data retrieval must comply with applicable privacy laws, data-provider terms, and authorization requirements.

4. **Intelligent Medical Coding** – AI-assisted ICD-10 diagnosis coding, sequencing, HCPCS review, and PDGM-related validation.
5. **Medicare Compliance & RCD Review** – Evaluate homebound status, skilled necessity, medical necessity, physician certification, and pre-claim review readiness.
6. **Recertification & Discharge Assistant** – Track certification periods, evaluate clinical documentation, and generate draft recertification justifications.
7. **Authorization Management** – Review payer requirements, prepare authorization packets, identify missing records, and draft appeal letters.
8. **Denial Prevention & Billing Readiness** – Cross-check orders, eligibility, documentation, and coding to identify potential claim denials.
9. **Clinical Documentation Improvement** – Identify inconsistencies, missing signatures, incorrect orders, and weak clinical documentation.
10. **AI Clinical Assistant** – Suggest patient-specific goals, interventions, patient education, and documentation improvements for clinician review.
11. **Scheduling & Field Operations** – Assist with clinician assignments, scheduling, route optimization, and travel-time planning.
12. **Analytics & Reporting Dashboard** – Display compliance scores, audit findings, patient status trends performance graphs downloadable reports.
13. **Document & Patient Management** – Secure PDF uploads document classification organized patient charts AI-powered document search.
14. **Security & Administration** – HIPAA-compliant architecture role-based access audit logs secure cloud storage data protection.

Additionally:
- We are particularly interested in developers who have built similar platforms before and can showcase their work or provide a demo of relevant past projects to demonstrate their expertise in this domain.

**Technical Requirements:**

- Integration with an existing advanced AI model through API.

- Clean modern responsive interface scalable architecture for additional modules future EHR integration full ownership of source code database application.

**Требования:** разрешение 4K и выше, фотореализм, высокая детализация, отсутствие AI-артефактов, корректная перспектива и освещение. 
Простая генерация в ChatGPT без проверки и доработки не интересует. Важно профессиональное владение нейросетями, понимание их возможностей и ограничений, умение выявлять и устранять ошибки генерации. Опыт работы с интерьерами необязателен. 
Первое задание — бесплатное тестовое, ориентировочно на 10–15 минут для опытного специалиста. Результат можно предоставить ссылкой на облачное хранилище в хорошем качестве. 
**Условия сотрудничества:** ищем постоянного подрядчика. Объём работы большой, много коллекций и артикулов. 
Ориентировочная стоимость единичного изображения высокого качества — 1500–2000 руб. Стоимость пакетной генерации (60–100 изображений) обсуждается индивидуально с учётом объёма, сложности замены материалов, различий между фактурами и необходимости корректировки промптов.

title: AI Developer to Build a Connected AI Platform for SME's
description:
We're Lamp, an AI department for service businesses in Egypt. We're starting with SMEs (clinics, real estate brokerages, academies and finance-related services) and we have clients waiting. This is a real project, not a test. The full scope is in the attached document.

What we're building
One platform with the Executive Brain at the center, and modules that plug into it: Finance & Accounting, Reception, Sales, Marketing and People. Operations is designed per business. Nothing here works in isolation, and that's the point. Every module reads from and writes to one shared data layer, so they feed each other. Reception's conversations tell Marketing what customers actually ask. A closed deal in Sales triggers an invoice in Finance and a welcome message from Reception. Marketing knows which ad brought a paying customer, not just a click, and Finance turns that into the real cost per customer. That connection is the product.

The Executive Brain
The owner's branded app, installable on web and phone, and the hardest part of the build. Each module has its own chat, and a CEO chat queries all of them and returns one answer, in Egyptian Arabic or by voice note. Every number is calculated from real data, never generated by the model, and every answer cites its source. The dashboard shows a health score per department with drill-down from the whole company to a single customer, an Approval Center for one-tap approval of discounts, payments and budget changes, and an impact tracker against the client's baseline. Every module sends its notifications through the Brain, with priority levels, a daily cap and quiet hours.

The modules
Finance & Accounting is our flagship. It connects to the client's existing accounting software, drafts invoices automatically, submits e-invoices and e-receipts to the Egyptian Tax Authority, matches payments across InstaPay, wallets, cards and bank transfers, and produces live financial statements, a 13-week cash forecast and what-if scenarios. Reception answers WhatsApp, social DMs and calls 24/7, manages bookings with a waitlist, recovers missed calls and hands chats to staff with a summary. Sales contacts every lead within a minute or two, qualifies and scores them, runs follow-ups that stop when the lead replies, and keeps the CRM updated from calls and chats. Marketing builds the content calendar from real customer conversations and ties ad performance to actual revenue. People gives staff an assistant that answers from company procedures, plus onboarding and leave requests on WhatsApp.

Quality
Our internal layer that watches every deployment. Every AI action is logged with what it did and why. Quality scores each module on a few KPIs, reviews samples plus anything flagged, catches wrong answers and frustrated customers, and every change is tested on saved real conversations before it goes live.

Ground rules
The AI never moves money. Numbers are calculated, not generated. Arabic comes first (Egyptian Arabic, Franco-Arabic and English, in text and voice). Access is least-privilege, and all accounts stay in the client's name.

Who we're looking for
A developer or small team with production experience in LLM agents and retrieval, the WhatsApp Business Platform, API integrations (CRM, accounting software, Meta and Google Ads), backend and databases, and an installable web/mobile app. Arabic NLP, voice AI or Egyptian Tax Authority e-invoicing experience is a strong plus.

Why work with us
Real clients and real deployments. We launch in stages for each client, so the work keeps coming. If you deliver well, you become our go-to team for every client project after this one. This is long-term work, not a one-off.

How to apply
Start your bid with the word "Lamp". Tell us which building blocks in the attached scope you've built before, with links or examples. Give a total estimate plus a breakdown by build stage, and tell us if you're solo or a team and who does what. Shortlisted candidates get an interview here on Freelancer, then a small paid milestone before the main build.

title: Mortgage Lead-Gen Platform Pilot Build
description:
I’m spinning up a proof-of-concept for KeepEasy Finance that lets Australian home buyers book a call with one of our brokers and, behind the scenes, creates a lead inside BrokerEngine using dummy data. The pilot will never touch production credentials—once the flow works, we’ll swap in live keys ourselves.

Here’s the flow I want to see:
• Prospect lands on a responsive page, enters basic contact details, then chooses a time slot that aligns with the broker’s Sydney schedule. 
• On submission, the system fires a test payload to BrokerEngine (or clearly logs the API call) so we can confirm the mapping. 
• Both prospect and broker receive confirmation emails. 

Deliverables:
• Front-end landing page + form. 
• Calendar/booking integration (Calendly, Google Calendar API, or similar). 
• Backend script demonstrating the BrokerEngine link with dummy data. 
• Clear deploy notes and a short screen-share walkthrough. 

Acceptance criteria:
1. A test lead appears in BrokerEngine’s sandbox or in a logged JSON object matching their schema. 
2. Email confirmations render correctly in AEST. 
3. Code is clean, commented, and can be redeployed with live keys in under an hour. 

I need at least three hours of overlap with Sydney business hours each day. Experience with Australian mortgage broking or BrokerEngine will earn extra points, but solid API integration work speaks for itself. title: Bespoke API-Powered Report Builder

API integrations: Ability to pull data automatically from several different third-party websites and platforms via their APIs and populate relevant sections of my reports.

Custom text fields: Ability to create editable text boxes throughout the report, allowing me to add my own commentary, descriptions and professional opinions.

Dropdown menus: Customisable dropdown fields with predefined options to ensure consistency and speed up report completion.

Photo uploads: Dedicated sections where users can upload photographs, arrange them within the report and add descriptions or captions.

Custom report templates: Ability to create, save and amend bespoke report templates, including different layouts and sections depending on the report type.

Dynamic content: The ability for information retrieved through APIs, dropdown selections and manual inputs to automatically populate the relevant sections of the report.

Report generation: Ability to generate a final, professionally formatted report, ideally in PDF format, with consistent branding, layouts, headers and footers.

User management: Ideally, multiple users should be able to log in, access the platform and create reports, with appropriate permissions.

The overall objective is to build a flexible, scalable reporting platform that combines automated data retrieval with manual input, allowing us to produce our own bespoke reports efficiently.

I am looking for a developer who can advise on the best technology and architecture for this project, assist with API integrations and deliver a fully functioning application with an intuitive, user-friendly interface.

title: Fintech Crypto Compliance Framework

Close collaboration with engineering and product is essential so that compliance controls are embedded directly into our codebase and operational playbooks.
